title: Network Engineer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role: Network Engineer / Sr. Network Engineer

Nebius is an AI-centric purpose-built for intensive GPU using company. As our global footprint accelerates toward multiple gigawatts of capacity, we are establishing our regional network engineering presence in the Asia-Pacific region.

We are looking for a hands-on, high-autonomy Network Engineer / Senior Network Engineer to drive the build-out, connectivity, and continuous production operations of our regional data centers, PoPs, and transport fabrics across APAC, with connectivity to EU/the US region and IP transit/PNI services.

In this role, you will be the boots-on-the-ground technical authority in the region. You will bridge low-level physical bringing-up with modern CLOS fabrics, collaborating closely with our core engineering teams in the EU (Amsterdam HQ) and the US within a global follow-the-sun operational model.

This position is fully remote within the APAC region (preferred hubs: Singapore, India), with periodic domestic/regional site visits and occasional sync trips to our engineering headquarters in Amsterdam.

Your Responsibilities Will Include:

  • End-to-End Infrastructure Ownership: Take complete operational and deployment ownership of the network stack across APAC sites—ranging from Day-0 Out-of-Band (OOB) part of network as seed , console setups, and management L2 switches to high-scale leaf-spine frontend fabrics (EVPN/VXLAN) 400g/800g/1,6T ready and regional DCI/Backbone boundaries (BGP/MPLS/SRv6).
  • High-Autonomy Site Bring-up & Operations: Act independently to triage, debug, and deliver connectivity in fast-moving, greenfield colocation environments. Make sound architectural and operational calls on short notice when counter parts oversight is offline.
  • Global Collaboration & Follow-the-Sun Alignment: Partner tightly with core architecture, backbone, and platform teams in the EU and US. Own regional operational handoffs, participate in global on-call rotations, and conduct changes in coordinated regional maintenance windows.
  • Team Scaling & Knowledge Offloading: As the APAC team expands, actively onboard new engineers, write rigorous runbooks, and offload operational pipelines to incoming peers to keep the team scalable.
  • Dynamic Execution: Operate effectively in a high-velocity environment where quarterly business priorities, cluster locations, and deployment schedules adjust dynamically to customer demand.

We Expect You to Have:

  • Proven Production Routing & Switching Depth: Solid hands-on experience operating Service Provider or Scale Data Center networks. Deep working knowledge of BGP, IS-IS (or OSPF), EVPN/VXLAN, SR-MPLS/SRv6, ECMP load balancing, and L3VPN architectures.
  • CLOS Fabric & L2–L4 Diagnostics: Strong diagnostic instincts in multi-tier Clos fabrics. Practical mastery of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack environments, packet analysis (tcpdump, Wireshark), interface error rates, and QoS queue behavior.
  • Full-Stack Network Mindset: Comfort with the entire operational pipeline: you are equally willing to console into an unconfigured management switch/OOB router at an unpolished greenfield site and tune BGP policy on multi-terabit edge borders (Juniper preferred, or relevant cisco/nokia).
  • Vendor Agility: Practical configuration and troubleshooting experience across modern network operating systems (Juniper Junos, Cisco IOS-XR, Arista EOS, or NVIDIA/Cumulus).
  • Startup Agility & Timezone Flexibility: Proven ability to self-direct, prioritize backlogs under ambiguous requirements, and maintain effective working overlap with European (CEST) and US (EST/PST) teams when critical milestones hit.
  • Communication: Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to document complex systems clearly and communicate concisely under Sev-1 pressure.

It Will Be an Added Bonus If You Have:

  • Practical scripting and network programmability skills (Python or Go, Git, NetBox, telemetry pipelines).
  • Practical exposure to high-performance AI networking: RoCEv2 (PFC, ECN/DCQCN, MCR) fabrics.
  • Experience interfacing directly with regional APAC telecom carriers, dark fiber providers, subsea consortiums, and local Internet Exchanges (e.g., Equinix IX, JPIX, SGIX).
  • Familiarity with Linux networking fundamentals, bridge-domains, and host-routed container networking (BGP-to-the-host).

  • Flexibility and ownership

title: Presales Architect
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Presales Architect.

About the job

This position is needed to drive technical wins and design scalable customer engagement solutions using Twilio's API platform.

As a Presales Architect, you will act as the trusted technical advisor for our most strategic enterprise prospects. You will bridge the gap between complex business problems and Twilio's powerful communication APIs, crafting innovative architectures that drive customer success. By partnering closely with the sales team, you will lead technical discovery, build compelling proofs-of-concept, and demonstrate how Twilio can transform a company's customer engagement strategy.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Partner with enterprise sales executives to lead technical discovery sessions, understanding complex business requirements and translating them into comprehensive Twilio solutions.
  • Design and architect scalable, secure, and resilient communication workflows using Twilio's suite of APIs (SMS, Voice, Video, Flex, etc.) tailored to client-specific use cases.
  • Develop and deliver compelling technical demonstrations, custom prototypes, and proofs-of-concept (POCs) that clearly articulate the business value of the Twilio platform.
  • Mitigate technical risks and overcome objections during the sales cycle by providing authoritative guidance on security, compliance, integration patterns, and architectural best practices.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to relay critical market feedback, feature requests, and emerging trends from the field to influence the Twilio roadmap.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in a presales, sales engineering, or solutions architecture role, preferably within the CCaaS, CPaaS, or broader enterprise SaaS industry.
  • Technical Skills: Demonstrated proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language (e.g., Node.js, Python, Java, or C#) and hands-on experience integrating and troubleshooting RESTful APIs.
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex cloud architecture, web security, and enterprise integration concepts for both technical and C-level non-technical stakeholders.

Desired:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Curious and willingness to work with ambiguity.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Singapore.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 50% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Working Student / Intern - Heating System
description:
WHO WE ARE

At Proxima Fusion, we’re driven by a bold mission – to redefine the future of sustainable energy. Our unique concept, built upon the groundbreaking W7-X stellarator and the latest advances in technology, paves the way for commercially viable fusion power plants. What’s more, our work in stellarator optimization, powered by cutting-edge computation and machine learning is propelling us into uncharted territories of fusion technology. New higher performance design points are unlocked by high temperature superconducting magnets and microwave tubes. To fully grasp this opportunity, we’re building a team of dedicated and passionate people who come together driving something extraordinary, radically transforming technology in the world.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You’ll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Join Proxima’s Alpha Engineering team and tackle one of fusion’s toughest physical challenges: heating the Alpha stellarator to hundreds of millions of degrees, where it fuses and begins producing its own energy. Alpha is Proxima’s flagship machine—the world’s first high-temperature superconducting stellarator—designed to de-risk the technologies needed for Stellaris, our future fusion powerplant.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Carry out test and modeling of microwave components - building software to quantify performance and allow these components to be effectively validated

  • Assembly and measurement of designed components to confirm sufficient performance.

  • Contribute to innovative designs for the heating system of the Alpha stellarator

WHO YOU ARE

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in electrical engineering, physics, or a related field. You must stay enrolled for the whole internship or working student contract.

  • High performers with excellent communication and problem-solving skills who love challenges and are not afraid to experiment, take risks, and learn from mistakes.

  • Experience in designing and analysing microwave components (COMSOL, CST, HFFS)

  • Experience with VNAs and RF system measurement

  • Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering particularly Python

LOGISTICS

Office: Munich, on-site.

Timings: 3 - 12 months full-time (part-time is possible) as an intern.

Start: Flexible between January - March 2027

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Behavioural and culture fit interview (15 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Test Technician
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run acceptance and characterization tests across incoming High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) tape, cables, intermediate assemblies, complete plate assemblies, and completed coils, supporting both development and production.

  • Prepare and identify test articles by cutting, soldering, terminating, mounting, and fixturing in accordance with the test plan. Install sensors, voltage taps, feedthroughs and measurement wiring with careful grounding and shielding.

  • Set up and operate dimensional inspection equipment, electrical instruments, high-current supplies, liquid-nitrogen baths, cryostats, cryocooler-based rigs and vacuum systems after training and authorization.

  • Carry out critical-current and n-value measurements, joint-resistance, insulation-resistance and high-voltage insulation tests, plus visual and dimensional checks, using approved methods.

  • Configure data acquisition and check connections, signal quality and instrument settings before each run. Follow test sequences precisely, monitor sample behavior and pause or stop at defined limits or unexpected conditions.

  • Maintain full traceability of sample identity, test configuration, instrument settings, raw data, observations and deviations so that results and setups can be reproduced.

  • Check data for completeness and plausibility, reduce and present results clearly, and compare them with defined acceptance criteria. Record all deviations, escalate suspect results or failures, and obtain approval before changing acceptance criteria.

  • Troubleshoot test setups, wiring, instrumentation, and data acquisition. Distinguish test-article behavior from measurement faults, involving equipment technicians for machinery or rig repairs beyond approved routine care.

  • Keep rigs ready for testing through pre-use checks, calibration-status verification, approved routine care and consumables management. Coordinate servicing and calibration, and recheck the test configuration after maintenance.

  • Commission new fixtures with design and test engineering, and help turn development setups into documented, repeatable operations.

  • Support failure investigations through post-test inspection and, when authorized in an agreed investigation plan, sectioning and other destructive examination.

     

WHO YOU ARE

 

  • A technical apprenticeship or qualification in electronics, mechatronics, laboratory work or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Hands-on testing, laboratory or measurement experience in an industrial, research or engineering environment.

  • Practical electrical measurement skills.

  • The ability to read engineering drawings and wiring diagrams and work precisely to a formal test procedure.

  • Experience using data-acquisition systems and basic data reduction, with accurate record-keeping and the judgment to question implausible results.

  • A disciplined approach to safety, configuration control and traceability.

  • The ability to work across teams, communicate observations clearly and adapt as hardware and test methods develop.

  • Working English for following procedures, recording results and discussing technical findings.

  • Ln2 Experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with superconductoring, high or low temperature, cables or magnets, including critical-current measurements.

  • High-current DC testing or quench detection.

  • Experience with cryogenic testing, liquid nitrogen or helium, cryocoolers or vacuum systems.

  • Specialist low-level instrumentation experience, including voltage taps, feedthroughs, sensor mounting, grounding and shielding.

  • CAD literacy for reviewing or developing test fixtures.

  • Python or LabVIEW for test automation, data handling, and plotting.

  • German language skills.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

 

This job would require frequent travels to our office in Villigen ( Zurich, CH)

title: Robot Learning Engineer, Human Motion Data (m/f/d)
description:
About EASE

EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.

The role

Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to turn that data into skills our humanoid can actually perform, so that human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks.

What you'll do

  • Map human motion onto humanoid kinematics and close the embodiment gap

  • Train manipulation and whole-body policies with imitation and reinforcement learning

  • Evaluate in Isaac Lab or MuJoCo and on our in-house humanoid, and measure the value of our data

  • Define what data training needs and help build our training setup, including GPU compute

  • Turn new research on robot foundation models and VLAs into prototypes

What you bring

  • Master's or PhD in robotics, CS, ML or similar, with hands-on experience from industry or research

  • Imitation or reinforcement learning on real robots (e.g. Diffusion Policy, ACT, PPO)

  • Strong Python and PyTorch; C++ is a plus

  • Physics simulation and sim-to-real transfer

  • Solid kinematics, dynamics and control

Nice to have

  • Learning from human data (egocentric video, motion capture, retargeting)

  • Humanoids, legged robots or exoskeletons; publications at CoRL, RSS, ICRA or NeurIPS

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. What you have built matters more than a perfect match.

What we offer

  • Data almost nobody else has, from a product in series deployment

  • Our own humanoid and the chance to build Physical AI at EASE from the ground up

  • Competitive salary plus virtual stock options (VSOP)

  • Flexible hours, hybrid in Munich, mobility benefit

  • Budget for conferences and further training

How to apply

Send your CV with links to GitHub, papers or robot videos.

Martin Fleischer, CEO & Co-Founder

EASE is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants need a valid work permit for the EU.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers.

Tasks

  • Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use

  • Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely

  • Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards

  • Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems

  • Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team

Requirements

  • Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language

  • You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site

  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through

  • Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German

  • Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria

Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously.

Benefits

  • Early team member with real ownership – your work ships to paying customers, not a demo

  • Employee stock options: you own part of what you build

  • New office in Zürich Kreis 5

  • Modern, AI-first toolchain – we invest in whatever makes you faster

  • Work directly with the founders

TELUS Digital AI Community

Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.

Equal Opportunity

title: Site Reliability Engineer  - AI Assisted Platform (OPCP) (m/f/d)
description:
At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.

As a leading tech company, we've been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign.

Within our #OneTeam, you'll shape the automation-first framework that lets every product team ship securely and at speed on top of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

· Kubernetes · GitOps · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Ansible · Terraform · OpenStack · Linux · CI/CD

· Python · Bash · Go · Observability (Metrics, Logs, Traces) · LLMs · Agentic Coding Tooling

Your Role💻

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of platform engineering, AI-driven tooling and security by design. Together with your team, you'll build the framework to package and deploy software solutions on top of OPCP - turning vague product ideas into repeatable, observable and self-healing services. You'll work on the conception, automation and operation of the platform, drive continuous improvements and help new teams onboard with the framework and OPCP. Working hand in hand with developers, security specialists and AI researchers, you keep an overview in ambiguous situations, analyze systems and make well-founded decisions based on that analysis.

AI-assisted engineering is part of our daily toolchain because it materially improves how we build and operate the platform – from spec-driven development with LLM assistance and knowledge-base-driven retrieval for incident response and design to agentic coding workflows and faster runbook authoring and review. We are investing in this direction as a structural part of our engineering practice and are looking for teammates who already work this way – not because it is trendy, but because they have seen it compound their own output.

Your Tasks

  • Design, build and maintain the Cloud Store packaging framework that standardizes how software is delivered on OPCP.

  • Extend and evolve the AI substrate - LLM-driven code assistants, knowledge-base retrieval and agentic coding hooks - that amplifies our engineering output.

  • Create and curate agentic coding environments: custom agents and sub-agents, slash commands, hooks and prompt engineering pipelines that become everyday developer tools.

  • Own the knowledge-base layer that powers AI-driven incident response, design assistance and runbook generation.

  • Drive our Kubernetes stack forward and implement robust GitOps pipelines (FluxCD / ArgoCD) for continuous delivery.

  • Write, publish and continuously improve OPCP onboarding runbooks and best-practice guides for internal product teams.

  • Analyze opaque system behavior, surface root causes and deliver concrete, data-backed improvement proposals - even when initial requirements are unclear.

  • Develop, version and operate the Infrastructure as Code stack (Terraform, Ansible) that underpins the platform, and take part in our on-call rotation.

What we offer you💼

  • AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including agentic coding tooling, knowledge bases as the backbone of our AI workflows and room to push our engineering practices further

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.)

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages

  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, ideally in a security-focused, highly automated environment

  • Proven practice of AI-assisted engineering - you use LLMs for spec-driven development, runbook authoring or agentic coding and have seen it compound your own output

  • Deep knowledge of Linux/Unix internals, system administration and performance tuning

  • Hands-on experience with OpenStack (or a comparable cloud platform) for infrastructure provisioning and management

  • Strong skills in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Ansible and the ability to model complex environments as code

  • A solid background in Kubernetes and GitOps workflows (FluxCD / ArgoCD) as well as in designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

  • Hands-on experience with modern observability stacks - metrics, logs and traces

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation with Python, Bash and Go

  • A solid grasp of security fundamentals (IAM, secrets management, hardening, compliance) and distributed systems concepts (CAP theorem, consensus, fault tolerance)

  • A clear bias toward automation over manual toil, a passion for continuous improvement and strict documentation discipline

  • You thrive in collaborative product teams, bring a strong ownership mentality, a blameless culture mindset and strong communication skills, and you adapt easily when things change

title: Junior Software Developer - Python & Web Applications (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your team
This job is with Statista R, a vertical business unit of Statista.

Statista R is a world leader in the creation of company, brand, and product rankings and top lists, based on comprehensive market research and data analysis: Statista R recognizes the best.

With a team of over 100 expert analysts and in cooperation with more than 40 high profile media brands across all continents like Forbes, TIME Magazine and Newsweek, Statista R creates transparency for consumers and business decision makers and helps companies build trust and recognition across a plethora of industries and product categories. A team of over 50 licensing specialists based in New York, Hamburg, Tokyo, and Singapore offers the awarded companies meaningful and eye-catching opportunities to communicate their success via logos and other award related products. Visit rankings.statista.com for further information about Statista R and our rankings.

Your Role

  • Design, build and maintain web applications for working with data as a core part of your role, mainly using Python frameworks such as Django and Streamlit

  • Work closely with our senior Data Engineer and other experienced data professionals who build our analytics products and pipelines, learn hands-on about our AWS cloud environment and ETL processes, and help build reliable data pipelines and PostgreSQL queries

  • Prepare, transform and validate data so our applications and analyses rest on a solid foundation

  • Create visualizations and insight reports that make findings clear and actionable, both to make our analyst team's processes more efficient and to produce strong client-facing materials

  • Work with teammates to turn analytical questions into usable features and workflows, and develop repeatable ways to build expertise and value for our stakeholders

  • Support projects based on large-scale, survey-based market research data, and help develop methods that complement our existing ranking products

Your Profile

  • Solid hands-on skills in Python, gained through professional work, internships, research, or your own projects. Experience coding in R is advantageous

  • Experience building web applications with Django and/or Streamlit is a strong plus. Knowledge of PostgreSQL or another SQL database, and basic HTML, CSS or JavaScript, is also a plus

  • A basic understanding of cloud environments such as AWS and of ETL concepts, and the motivation to grow these skills alongside experienced colleagues

  • Hands-on experience working with data, including querying, cleaning, analyzing, visualizing and checking data quality

  • Clean coding habits that make teamwork easy, such as readable code and basic Git workflows

  • Enjoyment in building tools other people use, a collaborative way of working, and the curiosity to dig into unfamiliar problems

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens.

Ce que nous construisons

    • Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.
    • Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.
    • Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
    • Everyday financial services : Avec helios by Younited, nous proposons des solutions pour aider chacun à mieux gérer ses finances, tout en construisant notre future offre bancaire du quotidien.
Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

    • Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.
    • Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec.
    • Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître.
    • Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat.
    • No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble.
Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Contexte 📄

Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, tu pilotes l’équipe Sécurité Financière de 1ère ligne de défense (LOD1), en charge du traitement des alertes LCB-FT et de screening.

Depuis 2024, Younited a engagé sa transformation pour devenir un acteur bancaire global. Dans ce contexte, tu joues un rôle clé dans la structuration et la fiabilisation du dispositif de sécurité financière, en garantissant la qualité des analyses, le respect des délais et des procédures, ainsi que la maîtrise des risques opérationnels.
 
À la croisée des enjeux opérationnels, réglementaires et managériaux, tu fais le lien entre les exigences de conformité et leur mise en œuvre concrète par les équipes. Tu contribues ainsi à renforcer les contrôles de 1er niveau, à fiabiliser le pilotage de l’activité et à accompagner l’évolution des outils et des pratiques.
 

Missions 🚀 

1) Opérations de sécurité financière (LOD1)
  • Superviser les entrées en relation et les diligences KYC (KYC renforcé, revues périodiques) avec escalade des profils les plus risqués à l’équipe en charge de la LOD2 pour validation
  • Garantir le traitement de 1er niveau des alertes de transaction et de filtrage (sanctions, gel des avoirs, PPE) et l'escalade des alertes documentée vers l’équipe en charge de la LOD2
  • Piloter la gestion des comptes inactifs et le cycle de blocage, d'investigation et de clôture des comptes en lien avec l’équipe en charge de la LOD2
  • Superviser les flux sensibles (virements sortants, recalls, chargebacks)
  • Exécuter les saisies et piloter le prestataire externe en charge des réquisitions judiciaires

2) Pilotage de l'activité

  • Piloter les SLA par flux et s’assurer de leur respect
  • Piloter le prestataire externe et suivre la qualité du traitement des réquisitions judiciaires
  • Être l'interlocuteur opérationnel de l’équipe en charge de la LOD2 sur les sujets LCB-FT

3) Contrôle, remédiation et transformation

  • Piloter la remédiation des recommandations d'audit et de contrôle jusqu'à leur clôture
  • Suivre les audits et le contrôle permanent et les plans d'action associés
  • Déployer le plan de contrôle de 1er niveau et renforcer les contrôles insuffisants et les actions correctrices
  • Rédiger et maintenir l’ensemble des procédures et modes opératoires du département
  • Former et accompagner l'équipe sur le traitement des alertes de surveillance des opérations et à la rédaction des examens renforcés
  • Faire évoluer les outils et automatiser les traitements, en accompagnant l'équipe dans le changement
  • Participer à la consolidation des données pour les comités des risques

4) Reporting réglementaire

  • Coordonner avec, l’équipe en charge de la LOD2, la production de données fiables et leur analyse, pour les reportings et les demandes des superviseurs
  • Structurer et automatiser les indicateurs de l'activité

5) Management

  • Encadrer l'équipe et la faire monter en compétences
  • Organiser l'activité selon les risques ; piloter les délais, les stocks et la qualité
  • Appuyer l'équipe sur les dossiers complexes et sensibles avant escalade

À propos de toi 👇

  • Tu as 7 ans d’expérience minimum en sécurité financière et fraude dans un établissement bancaire, une fintech ou un cabinet de conseil, dont une expérience en management d’équipe opérationnelle
  • Tu as une expérience concrète de structuration ou de refonte d’un dispositif opérationnel : procédures, contrôles de 1er niveau et outils
  • Tu as déjà piloté la remédiation de recommandations d’audit ou de contrôle
  • Tu sais traduire les exigences de conformité en pratiques opérationnelles claires
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance de la réglementation bancaire, notamment du contrôle interne, de la LCB-FT, du RGPD et de la DSP2
  • Tu es capable de conduire un projet transverse, de prioriser les actions et d’accompagner le changement
  • Tu fais preuve d’autonomie, de rigueur d’analyse, de capacité de décision, de pédagogie et d’implication directe dans les travaux

Processus de recrutement 📅

  • Premier échange en visio avec Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, pour apprendre à se connaître, échanger autour de tes motivations et te présenter plus en détail Younited (30 min)
  • Second échange en visio avec Antoine, ton futur manager et directeur des opérations chez Younited pour parler des attendus du poste de manière plus approfondie (60 min)
  • Une étude de cas à restituer en physique pour évaluer tes compétences au travers d’une mise en situation appliquée à une problématique liée au poste (60 min)
  • Un dernier entretien en visio avec Rémi, ton futur N+2 et CEO France chez Younited, pour valider l’alignement global sur le poste et les évolutions possibles (30 min)

🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ?

  • Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)

  • Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome)

  • Un état d’esprit entrepreneurial et un fort esprit d’équipe

  • Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited

  • Un environnement d’apprentissage continu avec la possibilité de bénéficier de formations externes et internes, plateforme de e-learning et des « Friday workshops » au sein de l'équipe Tech, pour accompagner le développement de chacun

  • Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso

  • Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés

  • Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales

  • Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an

  • 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT)

  • Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel 

  • Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur

  • Des team buildings en France (Summer Party et Winter Party), à l’international et en équipe

Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

title: PKI & IAM Engineer
description:
................

Für ein langfristiges Projekt (mit Aussicht auf Festanstellung falls gewünscht) bei unserem Kunden aus der Finanzbranche in Zürich, suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n und aufgeschlossene:n PKI & IAM Engineer.

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung für den Betrieb, die Weiterentwicklung und die Absicherung moderner Zertifikats‑ und Identitätslösungen und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zur unternehmensweiten Security‑Architektur.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Betrieb, Weiterentwicklung und Lifecycle‑Management der Microsoft PKI‑Infrastruktur (AD CS) sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen und sicheren Zertifikatsbetriebs
  • Verwaltung von Zertifikatsdiensten, Templates, CRLs, Policies und zugehörigen Lifecycle‑Prozessen
  • Planung, Integration und Betrieb externer Zertifikatsdienste inklusive SSL/TLS‑, S/MIME‑ und Code‑Signing‑Zertifikaten sowie automatisierter Zertifikatsprozesse über ACME
  • Automatisierung von Zertifikats‑ und Identity‑Prozessen mittels PowerShell, APIs und geeigneten Automatisierungswerkzeugen
  • Sicherstellung der Compliance‑, Security‑ und Governance‑Anforderungen im PKI‑Umfeld
  • Mitwirkung bei der Planung, Implementierung und dem Betrieb von Identity‑ und Access‑Management‑Lösungen
  • Unterstützung bei der Definition und Umsetzung von Rollen‑, Berechtigungs‑ und Zugriffskonzepten (RBAC)
  • Integration zertifikatsbasierter Authentifizierungsverfahren wie Windows Hello, Client‑Zertifikate oder Smart‑Card‑Login in bestehende IAM‑Prozesse
  • Beratung und Unterstützung interner Teams bei der sicheren Nutzung von Zertifikaten, Identitäten und Zugriffslösungen
  • Mitarbeit in spannenden Projekten rund um Identity, PKI und Security Themen

Dein Profil:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich PKI Engineering und Zertifikatsmanagement, insbesondere mit Microsoft AD CS
  • Praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit ACME sowie externen Zertifikatsdiensten und Zertifizierungsstellen
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Identity & Access Management, insbesondere Rollen‑ und Berechtigungsmanagement sowie Identity Governance
  • Verständnis gängiger IAM‑Konzepte wie RBAC, Least Privilege, Privileged Access Management (PAM) sowie Provisioning und Deprovisioning
  • Erfahrung in der Integration von PKI‑basierten Authentifizierungsverfahren in IAM‑Prozesse
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in PowerShell sowie Erfahrung in der Automatisierung von PKI‑ und Identity‑bezogenen Aufgaben
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft SQL Server und SQL‑basierten Datenbankumgebungen
  • Zertifizierungen im Bereich PKI, Microsoft Security oder Identity Management von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Web‑Applikationen mit C# / ASP.NET /.NET von Vorteil
  • Hochschulabschluss in Informatik (HF, FH oder Universität) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Analytische und konzeptionelle Denkweise sowie ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis im Enterprise‑Umfeld
  • Kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit hoher Teamorientierung und Verhandlungsgeschick
  • Fliessend Deutsch- sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

title: Member Support Specialist
description:
Fruitful is the financial membership that transforms every paycheck into progress—guided by experts and powered by AI automation. Through our proprietary Money Map, Fruitful converts financial advice into a personalized money system that automates someone's entire financial life with a single click—closing the long-standing execution gap in financial planning. Members partner with a dedicated CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® who designs and oversees their Money Map, allocating income across bills, spending, savings, and investments, putting their money on autopilot to drive measurable progress.

We're looking for an incredible person to join our Hospitality team and help push Fruitful forward.

Fruitful has the opportunity to be more affordable, accessible, and comprehensive than anyone in the industry, and it starts with a world-class member experience… Ready to help us build it?

Hospitality @ Fruitful

Our Hospitality team goes beyond traditional customer service, offering members exceptional care at every step of their journey. As a Member Support Specialist, you'll be the consistent, knowledgeable voice our members rely on — handling day-to-day support while helping us build the systems, documentation, and processes that will shape how this function grows.

As Member Support Specialist, you will:

  • Own the member support queue end-to-end — triaging, responding to, and resolving inbound email inquiries with care and consistency
  • Handle phone callbacks from our main support line, returning calls within defined SLA windows
  • Manage membership and account inquiries including cancellations, billing questions, banking and account servicing issues
  • Identify and escalate issues that require input from our Guidance, Bank / Investing Ops, or Engineering teams
  • Contribute to building our internal knowledge base, macro library, and documentation
  • Flag recurring issues and help develop solutions so the same problems stop landing in the queue
  • Work a set schedule of 9am-6pm PT, four weekdays plus one weekend day. Remote from any time zone; hours are anchored to 9am-6pm PT (e.g., 12-9pm ET). Schedule may change in the future as different needs arise.

Your Background & Values

  • 2–3 years of experience in a member-facing, customer-facing, or support role
    Strong written communication skills — you write clearly, warmly, and without jargon
    A genuine care for the people you're helping, not just closing tickets but actually solving problems
    Highly organized and able to manage your own time and priorities in a remote environment
    Energized by process and improvement — you notice when something keeps breaking and want to fix it
    Comfortable with ambiguity and working somewhere that's still being figured out
    Familiarity with a support tool like Zendesk, Intercom, or Freshdesk is a plus
    Experience in fintech, banking, or financial services is preferred

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package including salary and equity
    Flexible, self-directed time-off
    Fully remote
    Work-from-home setup stipend
    401(k) program with company match
    Comprehensive health benefits package with a substantial employer subsidy

Fruitful is building a team that seeks to represent the diversity of our member base. We are an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourage applicants from every background and life experience without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Benefits Analyst - East Region
description:
About Bennie

Bennie (www.bennie.com) is an employee benefits services and technology firm that helps companies create a healthier workplace. Bennie provides services and technology that are beyond what growing companies typically receive, yet exactly what they need.

Bennie has built the ultimate benefits platform that connects disparate systems across the benefits supply chain to deliver a complete experience for employees, employers, and partners. Bennie’s technology, benefit plans, and service model are designed to enable employers and their employees to experience best-in-class outcomes that reduce overall health plan costs. Bennie’s team members use the platform and its data to supplement their market knowledge and bring innovative solutions to Bennie’s customers.

Bennie is headquartered in Stamford, CT, and is a remote-first company with employees across the U.S.

Core Values at Bennie

As an organization, we value our team members who are Optimistic, Accountable, Thoughtful, and Healthy. We believe these values, known as our O.A.T.H., are essential for our collective success. The ideal candidate for this role will embody these values by:

  • Maintaining a positive attitude throughout our journey of building our company.
  • Being responsible for the quality of their work and for meeting their goals.
  • Respecting our differences and looking out for one another.
  • Believing in living complete lives that balance our work and personal time.

About the role:

The Benefits Analyst is responsible for supporting the consulting delivery team in achieving exceptional customer results and satisfaction. The Benefits Analyst should have relevant work experience in the benefits industry, with robust knowledge of Microsoft Excel, and other data analysis and modeling tools.

Reporting to: Principal Benefits Consultant

Who You Are: The ideal candidate should possess exceptional analytical, communication, and relationship building skills; and is excited to join a fast-growing benefits brokerage and work with senior team members to help deliver exceptional consulting service and experience to Bennie’s customers.

The Benefits Analyst should exhibit the six core attributes of the Bennie consulting team:

  1. Possess a growth mindset to drive the business upward and forward.
  2. Take a proactive approach to value creation and delivery for customers, colleagues, and partners.
  3. Seize the consultative opportunity in every interaction with customers, colleagues, and partners.
  4. Maintain a curiosity about the industry, Bennie’s customers, and Bennie’s business.
  5. Bring relentless intensity to the creation of value.
  6. Work collaboratively with customers, colleagues, and partners.

Responsibilities include:

  • Partner with the customer delivery team to create customer deliverables, including but not limited to benefit guides, open enrollment presentations, customer reporting, cost modeling, benchmark analysis, and more.
  • Support the customer request for proposal process, including data gathering, carrier marketing, proposal exhibit development and plan comparison, and other related tasks.
  • Serve as the project manager for insurance carrier implementation for assigned customers.
  • Execute onboarding tasks for new Bennie customers.
  • Support quality assurance efforts, including but not limited to enrollment audits, benefit plan set up review, and customer billing review.
  • Support execution of the annual customer account plan for all assigned customers.
  • Support process improvement initiatives that support the ongoing evolution of Bennie’s consulting model and customer service model.
  • Develop strong relationships with customers and benefit industry partners.

Requirements:

  • Working knowledge of MS excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • 1-2 years experience working in the benefits consulting or healthcare industry
  • Ability to work in the US

Nice to Have:

  • Life & Health Producer’s License
  • Certification in data analysis or MS Excel
  • Working knowledge of at least one benefits administration or HRIS system

Compensation & Benefits:

We offer a competitive salary for this fully remote position, commensurate with experience and qualifications. The estimated annual salary range for this role is USD60,000 to USD85,000*.

*Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Please note that the compensation details listed above reflect the base salary only, and do not include incentive pay, equity, or benefits. Bennie offers a total rewards package that includes stock options and employee benefits for full-time employees.

Our total rewards package includes the following:

  • Flexible Time Off: We have a flexible vacation policy and offer paid company holidays
  • Remote-first environment: Bennie is 100% remote (must be based in the US)
  • Health Benefits that includes:
    • Medical/Dental/Vision
    • HSA & FSA, HRA, Life, Disability, & Employee Assistance Program
  • Wellness Benefits that includes:
    • Headspace
    • Wellhub
    • Rocket Lawyer
    • One Medical Membership
    • Kindbody
    • Financial education with Betterment
  • Stock Options: All full-time employees are granted stock options
  • Remote Work Stipend: A $1,000 WFH Stipend
  • Paid Parental & Bonding Leave
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program

Bennie is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Bennie is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Consultant, Stars Consulting Center of Excellence
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Consultant, Stars Consulting Center of Excellence

Why We Have This Role

At Qualtrics, we help organizations understand people’s experiences and use those insights to drive meaningful clinical, operational, and quality improvements. Following the integration of Press Ganey into Qualtrics, our Stars Consulting Center of Excellence brings together deep healthcare expertise and industry-leading experience management capabilities. As a Medicare Stars Consultant, you’ll be a hands-on practitioner who builds the analyses and deliverables powering consulting engagements across CAHPS, HEDIS, HOS, medication adherence, and operational measures. Working directly with health plans, medical groups, and consulting colleagues, you’ll identify performance gaps, execute complex workstreams independently, and help clients improve the experiences and outcomes of their Medicare Advantage members.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Turn analysis into action: Go beyond reporting results to personally execute deep-dive analytics, explain what’s driving performance, and build practical recommendations clients can implement.
  • Take ownership as a hands-on doer: Clarify the expected outcome, gather the right context, and drive complex workstreams and deliverables forward independently with minimal oversight.
  • Make complex information clear: Translate CMS Stars requirements, technical measure specifications, and analytical findings into compelling stories and recommendations different audiences can understand.
  • Build trusted relationships: Serve as a direct, credible point of contact for client workstreams—listening closely, following through on commitments, and communicating progress, risks, and recommendations early.
  • Stay focused as priorities shift: Balance multiple high-demand client engagements and tight deadlines while maintaining high analytical quality and attention to detail.
  • Help others learn: Create and deliver engaging training that gives health plan teams the knowledge and confidence to apply Stars and member experience best practices.
  • Work collaboratively: Bring together the right internal resources (including Qualtrics/Press Ganey data assets and Hyperlift analytics) and client stakeholders, establish clear responsibilities, and keep delivery moving.

How You’ll Grow

  • Deepen your expertise across Medicare Stars measures and the connections between member experience, clinical quality, and health outcomes.
  • Strengthen your end-to-end consulting skills through autonomous, client-facing data execution, executive presentations, training, and relationship management.
  • Expand your ability to translate CMS guidance, rate announcements, and technical changes into practical client strategies.
  • Develop your ability to integrate member experience insights (CAHPS/HOS) with clinical quality and operational analytics platforms like Hyperlift to inform high-impact improvement decisions.

Things You’ll Do

  • Construct and lead measure-level analytics: Help clients focus on their highest-impact Stars opportunities by executing measure-level performance trending, cut point and gap analyses, and member experience driver analyses across CAHPS, HEDIS, HOS, medication adherence, and operational measures.
  • Design achievable improvement plans: Partner with health plans and medical groups to assess clinical and operational processes, interpret data to identify underlying problems, and recommend targeted interventions.
  • Manage end-to-end workstream delivery: Deliver engagements that meet agreed expectations by managing defined scopes, work plans, timelines, deliverables, budgets, and outcomes while coordinating internal and client resources.
  • Lead client-ready deliverable creation: Build client confidence in decisions and next steps by serving as the direct contact for assigned workstreams and personally preparing data analyses, assessments, quality reviews, and executive presentations.
  • Deliver training and knowledge transfer: Help clients sustain improvements by designing and leading training sessions on Stars, member experience best practices, and process improvement.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and integrate insights: Keep client recommendations current and evidence-based by tracking CMS guidance, rate announcements, and technical specification updates, and integrating Stars analyses with Hyperlift analytics and CAHPS/HOS survey insights.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Hands-on experience supporting Medicare Advantage quality, Star Ratings, or member experience work, typically developed through 2+ years in a health plan quality/analytics role or healthcare consulting environment.
  • Demonstrated contributions to performance improvement initiatives with health plan stakeholders, including the specific programs you owned, analytical actions you took, and measurable outcomes you produced.
  • Direct experience in one or more of these areas:
    • HEDIS operations and rate improvement, including measure specifications, supplemental data, and medical record review.
    • CAHPS and member experience improvement across lines of business.
    • Medication adherence and Part D measures.
    • HOS and health outcomes measurement.
    • Government programs and quality requirements associated with Medicare Stars and NCQA.
  • Strong quantitative and data analysis skills using tools such as Excel, Access, SQL, or SAS, with proven ability to translate complex findings into clear recommendations.
  • Experience independently producing clear, client-ready documents and executive presentations, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Evidence of managing multiple competing priorities, meeting strict deadlines, and adapting quickly to changing client requirements.
  • A bachelor’s degree.
  • Strongly preferred: Experience with Special Needs Plans—D-SNP, C-SNP, or I-SNP—including their specific quality, compliance, and member experience considerations.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • We are a high-impact, hands-on consulting team focused on helping clients act on their data—not simply delivering static reports.
  • Our work integrates member experience, health plan quality, and Medicare Stars performance within our Stars Consulting Center of Excellence to solve complex problems from multiple angles.
  • We collaborate directly with major health plans and medical groups, grounding recommendations in their operational realities and member needs.
  • You’ll join a fast-paced, growing practice experiencing strong market demand, offering immediate ownership of meaningful client engagements and close collaboration with senior consulting leaders.
  • This role is remote within the United States, with up to 50% travel as needed to support key client engagements.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • 100% Performance based promotions -- not politics or tenure
  • Culture - Incredible work environment - you can wear jeans and bring your dog to the office, anytime
  • Quarterly team activities, winter and summer parties, and lots of Qualtrics swag

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

title: General Counsel
description:
Teamshares is a tech-enabled acquiror of SMEs, intending to be a permanent home when owners retire. Part holdco, part fintech, Teamshares programmatically acquires companies with $0.5 to $5 million of EBITDA from retiring owners, integrates them with the Teamshares platform, and helps employees earn company stock. Founded in 2019, Teamshares operates subsidiaries with consolidated revenue of $490 million across over 40 industries and 30 states.

We are in the early days of being a public company. Over the past several years, we have continuously adapted and strengthened our model — improving financial discipline, governance rigor, and operational systems across our network. This is a pivotal moment for our Legal team.

The Opportunity

We are seeking to hire a General Counsel – a pivotal senior hire as Teamshares navigates its next phase of growth. This individual will be the company's chief legal advisor to the board, and executive team, responsible for directing the legal function while playing an active role in shaping business strategy.

This is a rare role for someone whose ambitions extend beyond legal counsel, who wants to help build a public company, influence how it grows, and leave a lasting mark on how it’s governed and led.

What You'll Do

Public Company Compliance & Governance

  • Own all SEC reporting obligations including 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and proxy statement preparation and review.

  • Lead Sarbanes-Oxley compliance, insider trading policy enforcement, Regulation FD, and earnings call and quiet period mechanics.

  • Manage board governance, committee charters (audit, compensation, nominating), D&O insurance, and director independence determinations.

  • Serve as the primary legal liaison to independent directors and board committees from day one.

  • Help drive design and ongoing implementation of internal controls

Oversight of Legal Function

  • Iterate on the company's existing legal infrastructure (contract management systems, transactions and financing processes and documents, governance documents, compliance programs, and legal operations) and manage team members for continued success as a public company.

  • Continue to build scalable legal processes as Teamshares and its portfolio of subsidiaries grows.

  • Design and directly own processes for managing outside counsel engagement and spend

  • Oversee design of risk philosophy across all legal and corporate matters, including on capital financing and transaction matters

Employment & Equity Compensation

  • Manage the company's equity plans, including stock options, RSUs, and 409A valuations.

  • Draft and negotiate executive employment agreements, severance arrangements, and equity award documentation.

  • Advise on employment law matters across the Teamshares portfolio.

Crisis Management & Strategic Counsel

  • Serve as a calm, steady presence during shareholder demands, regulatory inquiries, or litigation, transactions, communicating clearly to the board without catastrophizing or minimizing real risk.

  • Provide real-time legal counsel that helps the CEO and leadership make better decisions, not just safer ones.

Basic Qualifictions

  • The ideal candidate is a business partner who understands our growth trajectory and fluently speaks the language of boards, investors, and operators, and who defaults to creative problem-solving rather than reflexive caution.

  • 10+ years of legal experience, including meaningful time at a public company or as outside counsel to public companies in an EGC context.

  • Experience working across multiple industries, bringing adaptable legal judgment and pattern recognition that transcends any single sector.

  • Deep, hands-on fluency in SEC reporting, SOX compliance, corporate governance, and public company operations.

  • Demonstrated experience building public company legal functions from scratch — including systems, teams, and processes — in resource-constrained environments.

  • Solid grounding in equity compensation, employment law, and executive agreements.

  • Strong commercial instincts and a track record of advancing business goals through smart, practical legal advice.

  • Outstanding communication skills and executive presence; comfortable presenting to boards and engaging with independent directors.

  • Low ego, high output — a builder and operator who wants to roll up their sleeves.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor existing junior legal talent and business stakeholders — this leader will set the tone for how legal thinking develops across the organization.

  • J.D. from an accredited law school.

Additional Skills/ Preferences

  • Transactional experience in M&A, capital markets, or both.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements and financing documents.

  • Intellectual property portfolio management.

  • Comfortability with data privacy compliance including GDPR, CCPA, and any applicable state or sector-specific regulations.

  • Experience with broad-based employee equity programs

  • Familiarity with State blue sky / securities laws.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Teamshares

Teamshares believes in supporting every team member with a competitive salary and a generous benefits package, including equity for all employees, exceptional medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, and paid parental leave.

We recognize and facilitate the tangible impacts each employee has on our mission, while maintaining a healthy work-life balance culture that emphasizes unplugging at the end of the day. Our team values time off and actually takes vacation. We embody a growth mindset and provide the support you need to grow in your career.

description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each memberâs life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries â from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets â including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review â as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity ð

As Corporate Counsel, Commercial, you will be the legal partner behind Carrotâs customer and vendor contracts. Day to day, you will negotiate, draft, and review a high volume of commercial agreements, including master services agreements, service level agreements, professional services agreements, and NDAs. You will partner closely with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions quickly, manage most matters from start to finish, and escalate high-risk issues when the moment calls for it.

About You â¨

You likely have:

  • A J.D. and membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 3+ years of legal experience, in-house and/or at a law firm, ideally with in-house transactional experience at a health plan or startup.
  • A strong grasp of contracting concepts and solid experience drafting, negotiating, and interpreting commercial and vendor agreements such as MSAs, SLAs, professional services agreements, and NDAs.
  • Experience counseling a sales organization.

Â 

Nice to Have â­

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts with global companies.
  • Experience with complex multi-party commercial agreements and vendor agreement review.
  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle management software, especially Ironclad.

  • Knowledge of the employee benefits, healthcare, and/or pharmaceutical industries.

Â 

Why This Role Matters ð§¡

Carrotâs contracts are how our mission reaches people. Every agreement with an employer, health plan, or health system shapes how well members around the world can access fertility and family-building care. In this role, you help Carrot say yes to growth in ways that protect the company, our customers, and the members we serve.

Because you will own most matters from beginning to end, your judgment directly affects deal velocity, customer trust, and revenue. You will be a visible, trusted partner to Sales and the broader business while helping a rapidly growing global company scale its commercial legal function.



Interview Process ð¤

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen â 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview â 30â45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews â 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation â 30 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Â 

Why Candidates Join Carrot ð

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Â 

Â 

Compensationð°

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support you in all aspects of life, inside and outside of work. Our benefits include comprehensive health and wellness coverage, retirement savings plans, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. This role is:

Base + equity roles:
Compensation for this role is structured as base salary plus equity, giving you ownership in Carrot's long-term growth. This role does not include an annual bonus or variable compensation.

  • Base Salary Range:Â  $140,000-$160,000
  • Geo-Tier Adjustment: ForÂ highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

Why Carrot?

Power Partners, and Modern Healthcareâs Innovators.
