title: Private Practice Enablement Specialist (PST)
description:
Our Mission

Healthie is an AI-Native, ONC Certified EHR for modern outpatient healthcare.Â 

Healthie is proud to power clinically excellent healthcare for over 40,000 providers who deliver clinically excellent healthcare - longitudinal and collaboratively, with patient and provider experiences at the center. Both healthcare and technology are undergoing unparalleled industry innovation, and itâs incredible to see the momentum - from consumers, from providers, and from reimbursement for this type of healthcare - grow exponentially.Â 

We provide the powerful infrastructure every care delivery organization needs. On the surface this includes EHR, Scheduling, Engagement, Billing, Data, and much more. Underneath the iceberg are thousands of configurations, settings, widgets, automations, and limitless capabilities because we are an API-first platform. Our fully brandable platform makes it easy for clinics and organizations of any size to scale and never reach a limit.Â 

Today, over 3 billion API calls are made to Healthie every month, as thousands of organizations who work with more than 21 million patients in total, rely on Healthie to deliver clinically excellent healthcare in over 35 specialties, from behavioral healthcare to complex chronic care management and personalized medicine.

We believe in the power of technology to improve access to healthcare and weâre building the rails that make this a reality. We work fast and with quality because we provide business-critical, healthcare-critical software that clinicians and patients need for a better healthcare system. Weâre customer-obsessed, operate with lightning-fast processes and responses, and always share our product roadmap publicly-Â  so customers can see what weâre building, and remain relentlessly focused on how care gets delivered.

Healthie is backed by leading investors, and while we've $42M raised to date, more importantly, we operate with fiscal responsibility and have been profitable for more than half of our time as a company. We know that building an ONC-Certified EHR is a lifetimeâs body of work, and we are here to build for our customers forever.

Learn more at https://www.gethealthie.com/

About the role

Weâre hiring a Customer Success Manager to join our Private Practice Enablement team and help customers get the most out of Healthie throughout their entire journey with us. Youâll work with private practices and growing healthcare organizationsâsome brand new to Healthie, others who have been with us for years.

This is a highly customer-facing role centered around understanding how practices operate and helping them use Healthie to accomplish their goals. Youâll build relationships with healthcare executives, practice managers, providers, and clinical champions, becoming a trusted resource as their workflows, teams, and needs evolve.

Our ideal hire is curious, resourceful, and a natural educator. You enjoy learning how different healthcare organizations work, can turn complex questions into clear next steps, and are excited to develop the product expertise needed to help customers use Healthie successfully.

About the work

  • Youâll spend much of your day connecting directly with customers through live 1:1 calls and email, helping with everything from initial setup and training to workflow optimization, feature adoption, and new needs that emerge as their practices grow.
  • Youâll learn how customers deliver care, understand their operational and patient care goals, and use deep product knowledge to recommend workflows that make Healthie work for their organization.
  • Youâll solve problems in real time. Sometimes thereâs a straightforward answer; other times youâll need to investigate, think creatively, test different approaches, or bring in the right people to find a solution.
  • Youâll create personalized resources, screen recordings, and examples when showing a customer how to accomplish something is more helpful than simply telling them.
  • Youâll manage multiple customer conversations and priorities at once, adapting your communication and approach to different practices, personalities, and challenges.
  • Youâll collaborate with Support, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, sharing what youâre learning from customers and helping improve our product, resources, processes, and overall customer experience.


Details, details

  • This is a full-time, remote position and U.S. work authorization is required.
  • This job is Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm PST.Â 
  • Weâre seeking fluent English speakers/writers.
  • The salary range is $93,000 - $102,500

About you

Youâve done this kind of work before. Weâre looking for someone with 3â5 years of experience in Customer Success or similar customer-facing role. And it is a requirement that you've worked at a software company. Bonus points if youâve worked in healthcare technology, or have experience working with private practices or growing healthcare organizations.

  • Youâre comfortable independently leading customer conversations and building relationships with everyone from individual providers to practice managers and healthcare leaders. You ask thoughtful questions, listen closely, and know how to adapt your approach to the person in front of you.
  • Youâre a natural educator and an excellent communicator. You can take complicated products, workflows, and questions and turn them into clear, practical next steps. We value good writers.
  • Youâre curious about how customers work. You want to understand what someone is actually trying to accomplish before recommending a solution, and you enjoy learning the different ways healthcare organizations operate and deliver care.
  • Youâre a strong problem-solver with good judgment. When there isnât an obvious answer, youâre comfortable researching, testing different approaches, and using the resources around you to figure out the best path forward.
  • Youâre organized and self-directed. You can manage customer calls, emails, follow-ups, and projects simultaneously, take ownership of whatâs in front of you, and recognize when something needs another perspective or team.
  • Youâre good at navigating challenging conversations. You can set expectations, explain limitations, and provide thoughtful guidance even when the answer isnât exactly what a customer hoped to hear.
  • You have plenty of tech skills, and you're confident working across a variety of tools and apps, and can troubleshoot everyday issues on your ownâthings like browser quirks, connectivity problems, login hiccups, and mobile device settings.
  • Youâre a collaborative teammate and strong customer advocate. You share what youâre learning, give helpful and direct feedback, and bring patterns from customer conversations back to the broader team so we can continue improving how we support our customers and build Healthie.

How to applyÂ 

Please submit a PDF cover letter and introduce yourself. Include:

  • Tell us who you are and why you want this job at Healthie.
  • Where are you based and what time zone are you in?
  • Why do you want to work in Customer Success?

In your cover letter, answer these real-world customer scenarios. Reply to the customer directly like you would if you worked on our Private Practice team. Also tell us how youâd approach the conversation, and explain your thinking for each reply.Â 

  • A customer recently signed up for Healthie and is excited to get started. They want to go live as soon as possible and have an upcoming appointment with a client. They need help manually adding the client to Healthie and sending them an invitation to access the platform.

  • A customer who has been using Healthie for several years reaches out because their practice has grown and their current workflow is no longer working well for their team. They have a specific idea for how theyâd like to solve the problem, but you arenât sure whether Healthie can support exactly what theyâre asking for.Â 

Interview Process

  • Quick chat with our Talent team (15 minutes)
  • Interview with Talita, Private Practice Team Lead (30 minutes)
  • Interview with Justin, VP of Customer Support (30 minutes)
  • Live demo with Talita and Jen (30 minutes)
    • Youâll be asked to give us a brief product demo. Youâll share your screen and show us how to add a client and schedule an appointment.Â 
  • Final session with Talita and Justin (30 minutes)
  • Reference checks

Healthie is subject to HIPAA and other security and privacy frameworks, and this job entails training and conformance to expectations regarding security and compliance.

title: Compliance Officer/MLRO
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the worldâs leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 â connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Â 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Â 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Purpose

Lead the establishment and ongoing oversight of the Pakistan entityâs independent Compliance function and Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Counter-Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) framework.
During the pre-licensing phase, the role holder will lead Compliance-owned licensing deliverables, develop the local control framework and assess operational readiness. Following licensing, the role holder will discharge the entityâs CO/MLRO responsibilities, advise the Board and senior management, and maintain effective engagement with PVARA, the Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU) and other relevant authorities.
The role combines CO and MLRO responsibilities, subject to applicable regulatory requirements and any required regulatory acceptance or approval. The suitability of the combined arrangement will be reviewed periodically, considering independence, conflicts, capacity, resources and the entityâs nature, scale and complexity.
Â 

Key Responsibilities

  1. Licensing and Operational Readiness
  • Lead Compliance-owned components of the PVARA licensing application and coordinate relevant inputs from Legal, Business, Risk, Finance, Operations and Technology.
  • Develop and maintain a regulatory obligations register, licensing deliverables tracker and local implementation roadmap.
  • Assess gaps between group policies, systems and controls and applicable Pakistan requirements; oversee localisation and track remediation.
  • Establish local Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF policies, governance arrangements, escalation procedures and regulatory reporting processes.
  • Define local control requirements for customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, Travel Rule compliance and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Assess the suitability and readiness of local, group-provided and outsourced controls, including relevant pre-launch testing.
  • Provide a documented Compliance and AML readiness assessment to the appropriate governance forum, escalating unresolved material gaps before launch.
Â 
  1. Compliance Oversight
  • Establish, administer and maintain a documented, risk-based Compliance Management System (CMS) proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • Advise the Board, relevant committees and senior management on applicable legal and regulatory requirements, licence conditions and regulatory developments.
  • Develop and execute a risk-based Compliance Monitoring and Testing Plan; document findings, agree remediation ownership and deadlines with accountable functions, independently validate closure, and escalate overdue or inadequate remediation.
  • Oversee compliance with applicable conduct, customer protection, complaints-handling, client-asset and market-integrity requirements, according to the entityâs licensed activities.
  • Review proposed products, services and material business changes from a local compliance perspective, identifying requirements, restrictions and necessary controls.
  • Ensure material non-compliance is investigated, promptly escalated and remediated, and notified to PVARA where required.
  • Maintain regulatory submission and commitment trackers, overseeing timely and accurate Compliance-owned responses and escalating dependency risks.
  • Act as the primary Compliance liaison with PVARA for supervisory engagement, inspections and information requests.
  • Develop and oversee Compliance training for employees, senior management and relevant key individuals.
Â 
  1. AML/CFT/CPF and Financial Crime
  • Establish, implement and maintain the entityâs AML/CFT/CPF framework, aligned with applicable Pakistan legislation, regulatory requirements and relevant directions or guidance.
  • Lead the enterprise-wide financial crime risk assessment and oversee risk-based mitigation measures.
  • Oversee customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, customer risk assessment, enhanced due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
  • Oversee transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and targeted financial sanctions controls, including escalation and action on relevant alerts.
  • Oversee virtual asset-specific controls, including blockchain analytics, risks associated with unhosted wallets and Travel Rule compliance where applicable.
  • Receive and assess internal suspicious activity referrals, determine whether external reporting is required, and submit suspicious transaction reports to the FMU within applicable deadlines.
  • Exercise independent judgement on suspicious transaction reporting without requiring business approval, while maintaining confidentiality and preventing tipping-off.
  • Manage the entityâs FMU/goAML registration, access arrangements and reporting processes, as applicable.
  • Ensure required customer, transaction and investigation records are retained for applicable periods and remain accessible and retrievable.
  • Liaise with the FMU and other competent authorities on financial crime matters and oversee relevant information requests.
  • Oversee AML/CFT/CPF training and awareness, tailored to employeesâ responsibilities and exposure to risk.
Â 
  1. Governance, Reporting and Control Assurance
  • Provide periodic reports to the Board or designated committee on Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF effectiveness, material risks, incidents, findings and remediation progress.
  • Escalate urgent or material matters promptly rather than waiting for scheduled reporting.
  • Attend relevant Board and committee meetings and provide independent advice and challenge.
  • Assess and oversee group-provided and outsourced Compliance/AML services, including local regulatory suitability, service standards, data access, management information and escalation arrangements.
  • Oversee delegated Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF activities and remain accountable for discharging the CO/MLRO responsibilities, without displacing the responsibilities of the entity, Board, senior management or operational control owners.
  • Coordinate with Risk and Internal Audit, while preserving the distinction between Compliance oversight and independent audit assurance.
  • Support periodic review of the role holderâs continuing fitness, propriety and suitability, including the required review of the MLRO appointment.
  • Maintain effective handover and suitably qualified cover arrangements for absences, consistent with applicable regulatory requirements.
Â 

Qualifications and Experience

Essential
  • A degree in law, finance, business or a related discipline, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
  • At least eight yearsâ relevant Compliance and/or AML/CFT experience in financial services, including at least three years in a senior Compliance, MLRO or equivalent leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of Pakistanâs financial regulatory and AML/CFT framework, including the Virtual Assets Act, applicable PVARA regulations, the Anti-Money Laundering Act and FMU reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrable understanding of virtual asset business models and their financial crime, conduct and operational risks.
  • Practical experience with customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, investigations and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Experience developing risk assessments, policies, monitoring programmes and Board-level reporting.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into workable business, operational and technology controls.
  • Be resident in Pakistan by the date of the formal CO/MLRO appointment and maintain residency as required under applicable regulations.
  • Fluency in English and Urdu.
Â 
Desirable
  • Professional certification such as CAMS, an ICA qualification or an equivalent Compliance/AML credential.
  • Experience in virtual assets, exchanges, fintech or digital financial services.
  • Experience supporting a regulatory licence application or establishing a local Compliance function.
  • Experience engaging with PVARA, FMU, SECP, SBP or other relevant Pakistani authorities.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools and Travel Rule solutions.

title: Founding Account Executive (DACH)
description:
About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

We are looking for a Founding Account Executive to own and grow DACH for Condukt, by owning and closing complex, high-value enterprise deals across financial services.

In this role, you will lead the full sales cycle, from early discovery and solution design through negotiation and close, working with high-growth fintechs. You’ll operate as a trusted advisor to senior decision-makers, helping them navigate complex compliance challenges while unlocking growth with Condukt’s real-time identity and AI-powered platform.

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move with urgency, and are excited to help build both a category-defining product and a repeatable enterprise sales motion. You’ll work closely with Account Management, Product, Engineering, and Leadership to shape how we sell, who we sell to, and how we win.

If you thrive in consultative enterprise sales, enjoy solving hard problems with customers, and want meaningful influence over strategy and execution, this role is for you.

Owning DACH

This is our first role dedicated to DACH:

  • Carry the DACH number, from pipeline and forecast through to close

  • Open the territory from scratch and land our first local reference customers

  • Sell in German, and feed what you hear in the market back to Product

 

What you’ll do:

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle for new strategic customers in DACH, from first conversation through contract negotiation and close

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder deal processes (6+ months), navigating procurement, legal, security, and compliance reviews

  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Risk & Compliance, Product, Operations, and C-suite, positioning Condukt as a long-term strategic partner

  • Run discovery-led, consultative sales processes that deeply understand customer workflows, regulatory constraints, and success metrics

  • Craft and deliver executive-level and technical presentations, tailoring value propositions to diverse audiences

  • Partner closely across teams to ensure smooth handoffs, successful implementations, and expansion readiness post-close

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape roadmap priorities, providing structured feedback from the field

  • Contribute to the development of scalable sales playbooks, pricing frameworks, and go-to-market strategy for DACH

  • Represent Condukt at industry events, conferences, and customer forums in DACH

What you bring:

  • Native or professional German, plus fluent English

  • Proven experience closing complex enterprise SaaS deals with financial institutions, fintechs, or regulated enterprises

  • Strong track record of exceeding quota in long, consultative sales cycles (6+ months) with multi-six- and seven-figure ACVs

  • Ability to navigate large, matrixed organizations and influence multiple decision-makers and economic buyers

  • Deep commercial acumen paired with strong product intuition, being able to sell value, not just features

  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, equally comfortable with executives and technical stakeholders

  • Analytical, structured approach to sales, with comfort working with data, ROI models, and business cases

  • Self-starter mentality with resilience and adaptability in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

 

Bonus:

  • Experience selling compliance, risk, identity, fraud, or data infrastructure solutions

  • Background in fintech, banking, payments, or lending ecosystems

  • A network in the DACH fintech or financial-services ecosystem

  • Prior experience in early-stage or high-growth startups, or as a Founding Account Executive

  • Familiarity with API-first platforms or technical sales motions

  • Experience working closely with Account Management or Customer Success teams on expansion strategies

  • Additional languages (French or Dutch)

 

Our offer:

  • Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Remote from Germany with occasional travels to our London office

  • Flat hierarchy with direct access to the founders

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Private health insurance, plus sick and compassionate leave as needed

title: Kundenbetreuung, Genehmigungs- & Trainingsmanagement (m/w/d) – Drohnen im professionellen Einsatz
description:
Bielefeld oder remote innerhalb Deutschlands · Vollzeit oder Teilzeit

Über U-ROB

U-ROB gehört zu den etablierten Full-Service-Anbietern für Drohnenlösungen. Wir bringen Drohnen in den echten Einsatz. Dafür arbeiten wir mit mobilen Drohnen wie der DJI FlyCart 100, der DJI Matrice 5T und der Matrice 400, mit autonomen Dock-Systemen und mit intelligenter Flugsoftware. Außerdem entwickeln wir Detektionslösungen für die jeweiligen Bedrohungsszenarien unserer Kunden.

Wir sind ein schlagkräftiges Team. In dieser Rolle stehen die sorgfältige fachliche Begleitung komplexer Genehmigungsprojekte, die verlässliche Kundenbetreuung und die Organisation unserer Trainings im Mittelpunkt.

Worum es geht

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Position liegt im Genehmigungsmanagement für komplexe Drohneneinsätze. Du prüfst anspruchsvolle Einsatzvorhaben unter technischen, rechtlichen und operativen Rahmenbedingungen und stimmst die Anforderungen und Lösungswege eng mit unseren Kunden ab.

Du entwickelst genehmigungsfähige Betriebskonzepte, erstellst die erforderlichen Antrags- und Nachweisunterlagen und reichst sie bei den jeweils zuständigen Landes- und regionalen Luftfahrtbehörden ein. Rückfragen und Anpassungen begleitest du bis zur Entscheidung.

Daneben betreust du unsere Kunden rund um regelmäßig stattfindende Trainings zur Betriebskategorie „speziell“ und zu konkreten Drohnenlösungen. Du koordinierst Termine, Teilnehmende, Trainer, Unterlagen und Nachweise.

Hier kommen Technik, Recht und praktische Anwendung zusammen. Du arbeitest dich detailliert in Einsatzszenarien, technische Systeme und regulatorische Vorgaben ein, bewertest auch anspruchsvolle fachliche Fragestellungen selbstständig und überführst sie in fundierte, nachvollziehbare Unterlagen und umsetzbare Lösungen.

Was dich erwartet

  • Du prüfst und strukturierst komplexe Genehmigungsprojekte für professionelle Drohneneinsätze

  • Du analysierst Einsatzszenarien, technische Systeme, Betriebsbedingungen und rechtliche Vorgaben und entwickelst daraus genehmigungsfähige Betriebskonzepte

  • Du stimmst Anforderungen und Lösungswege eng mit unseren Kunden ab und übersetzt technische und operative Details in belastbare Antragsunterlagen

  • Du erstellst Anträge und Nachweise, reichst sie bei den zuständigen Landes- und regionalen Luftfahrtbehörden ein und bearbeitest Rückfragen bis zur Entscheidung

  • Du betreust Kunden rund um unsere regelmäßig stattfindenden Trainings und beantwortest fachliche und organisatorische Fragen

  • Du koordinierst Termine, Teilnehmende, Trainer, Schulungsunterlagen und Nachweise, pflegst die zugehörigen Vorgänge und hältst offene Punkte nach

  • Du führst ausgewählte Schulungen und Workshops selbst durch und vermittelst technische, rechtliche und praktische Inhalte verständlich

Was du mitbringst

  • Du begeisterst dich für Drohnen und bringst ein fundiertes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Systeme und Einsatzszenarien mit

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Genehmigungs-, Zulassungs- oder Regulierungsprojekten und kannst rechtliche, technische und behördliche Anforderungen sicher zusammenführen

  • Du verfügst über einen fachlichen Hintergrund, der dich zu detaillierter und fundierter Arbeit an technischen, rechtlichen und behördlichen Fragestellungen befähigt, zum Beispiel in Luftfahrt, Ingenieurwesen, Recht, Verwaltung, Sicherheitsmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich

  • Du kannst komplexe Vorgaben selbstständig prüfen, sauber dokumentieren und gegenüber Kunden sowie Behörden nachvollziehbar vertreten

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Planung und Organisation von Trainings, Schulungen oder vergleichbaren wiederkehrenden Formaten und kannst Inhalte sicher vor Gruppen vermitteln

  • Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig, analytisch und eigenständig und kommunizierst schriftlich wie mündlich klar und verbindlich auf Deutsch

Womit du zusätzlich punktest

  • Kenntnisse im europäischen Drohnenrecht sowie zur Betriebskategorie „speziell“, zu SORA, PDRA oder Flugrisikobewertungen

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Landes- und regionalen Luftfahrtbehörden

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit professionellen Drohneneinsätzen, etwa Inspektionen, Vermessungen oder Filmaufnahmen

  • Erfahrung als Trainer oder in der fachlichen Weiterbildung von Erwachsenen

Arbeitsort und Umfang

Die Position kann in Bielefeld oder remote innerhalb Deutschlands ausgeübt werden. Für einzelne Teamabstimmungen, Schulungen, Workshops oder Projekttermine ist Präsenz in Bielefeld oder beim Kunden erforderlich. Möglich sind Vollzeit und Teilzeit.

Deine Bewerbung

Wir möchten verstehen, wie du technische, rechtliche und behördliche Anforderungen fundiert zusammenführst und wie du unsere Kunden und regelmäßig stattfindenden Trainings zuverlässig betreust. Bitte füge deiner Bewerbung Folgendes bei:

  • Einen prägnanten Lebenslauf

  • Ein paar Sätze zu deinem fachlichen Hintergrund und deiner Erfahrung mit Genehmigungs-, Zulassungs- oder Regulierungsprojekten

  • Ein kurzes Beispiel für ein komplexes Vorhaben oder ein Training, das du geplant, geprüft oder begleitet hast

  • Deinen möglichen Starttermin und deinen gewünschten Stundenumfang

Du förderst aktiv die Entwicklung von Storylines, kreativen Ideen und innovativen Kommunikationskonzepten

Du stellst die reibungslose Vor- und Nachbereitung von PR- & Social Media Events sicher

Dein Wissen rund um mobile Kommunikation hältst du immer auf dem neuesten Stand

Die Kommunikation mit Influencern wird eigenverantwortlich von dir durchgeführt

Du bearbeitest Presseanfragen und pflegst Presseverteiler

Du kümmerst dich intensiv um deine Kunden und bist eine vertrauensvolle und verbindliche Ansprechperson

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Medien-, Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit sowie ausgewiesene Agenturerfahrung

  • Begeisterung für aktuelle Themen und Entwicklungen, insbesondere aus den Bereichen IT und Telekommunikation, Business Transformation und AI

  • Interesse an komplexen, erklärungsbedürftigen Zusammenhängen

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse

Remote-Flexi-Freiheit: Ob rund um Köln-Nippes, ob besonders früh oder ein bisschen später – wo und wann du arbeitest, bestimmst du mit.

Sabbatical | Workation: Wenn du mal richtig Fernweh bekommst, dann kannst du europaweit auf Workation gehen. Es soll noch ein bisschen mehr sein? Nimm dir ein Sabbatical.

title: Trainee Redaktion YouTube (all genders)
company: Miss Germany Studios GmbH & Co. KG
description:
Miss Germany ist kein Schönheitswettbewerb, sondern eine Plattform für Frauen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas bewegen wollen. Auf YouTube entwickeln wir eigene Formate, die Frauen zwischen 16 und 35 ansprechen – nicht nur mit den Geschichten und Perspektiven unserer Kandidatinnen, sondern mit allen Themen, die diese Generation bewegen.

Gute Formate stehen und fallen mit der Vorbereitung. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der gründlich recherchiert, Zusammenhänge schnell versteht und aus Fakten, Stimmen und Hintergründen eine Grundlage baut, mit der wir vor der Kamera überzeugen.

Als Trainee Redaktion YouTube bei Miss Germany Studios bereitest du unsere eigenen Formate inhaltlich vor – von der Themenidee über die Recherche bis zum festen Briefing für Dreh und Moderation. Dabei lernst du redaktionelles Arbeiten von Grund auf in der Praxis und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.

Was du bei uns machst:

  • Recherche: Du recherchierst Themen, Fakten, Studien und Hintergründe – gründlich, schnell und mit sauberen Quellen.

  • Themenfindung: Du behältst im Blick, was gerade diskutiert wird, und schlägst Themen und Gäst:innen für unsere Formate vor.

  • Briefings: Du bereitest deine Recherche so auf, dass Moderation und Team direkt damit arbeiten können: Fragen, Thesen, Argumente und Fakten.

  • Casting & Gäste: Du findest passende Gäst:innen und Protagonist:innen, nimmst Kontakt auf, führst Vorgespräche und bereitest sie inhaltlich auf den Dreh vor.

  • Faktencheck: Du prüfst Inhalte vor der Veröffentlichung auf Richtigkeit.

Wir haben ein Match, wenn Folgendes auf dich zutrifft:

  • Du bist neugierig. Du gibst dich nicht mit der ersten Antwort zufrieden, sondern gräbst weiter.

  • Du liebst Youtube. Du bist selbst gerne auf der Plattform unterwegs und konsumierst regelmäßig Formate.

  • Du recherchierst sauber. Du erkennst seriöse Quellen und weißt, wie man Fakten prüft.

  • Du bringst Dinge auf den Punkt. Aus viel Material machst du ein klares, kurzes Briefing.

  • Du bist hands-on und kommunikativ. Du greifst auch mal zum Telefon und hast keine Scheu vor Gesprächen. Erfahrung im Casting ist ein Plus.

  • Du verstehst YouTube. Du weißt, was ein Thema spannend macht und warum Menschen bis zum Ende dranbleiben.

  • Du übernimmst Ownership. Du hältst Deadlines, denkst mit und gehst einen Schritt weiter, statt auf Antworten zu warten.

  • Du willst durchstarten. Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung abgeschlossen – idealerweise in Journalismus, Medien, Kommunikation oder Sozialwissenschaften – oder bringst vergleichbare Erfahrung mit, z. B. aus Redaktion, Podcast oder eigenen Kanälen. Ab dem 15. Januar 2027 bist du mit 40 Stunden pro Woche dabei.

Du möchtest etwas aufbauen. Nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten.

Was wir bieten:

  • Build Something Big: 2027 wird Miss Germany 100 Jahre alt. Du gestaltest die Inhalte unserer YouTube-Formate in genau dieser Phase aktiv mit.

  • Impact Driven: Wir unterstützen mit Herzblut Frauen bei ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und tragen zu einer vielfältigeren und gleichberechtigteren Gesellschaft bei.

  • Raum für Ideen: Deine Themen und Formatideen landen nicht in der Schublade, sondern im nächsten Video.

  • Ownership statt Micromanagement: Viel Vertrauen, kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Verantwortung statt endloser Abstimmungsschleifen.

  • Base Köln: Du arbeitest von Köln aus – remote oder im Co-Working-Space. Ein festes Muster gibt es nicht, wir schauen gemeinsam, was passt. Für dein Onboarding sowie regelmäßige Team- und Produktionstage kommst du nach Oldenburg in unser Head Office.

  • Work with Inspiring People: Du arbeitest mit beeindruckenden Frauen, spannenden Persönlichkeiten, Partnern und einem Netzwerk, das weit über Miss Germany hinausgeht.

  • Learn Fast: Recherche, Redaktion, Storytelling, YouTube, Personal Brands und Medien – du wirst in kurzer Zeit unglaublich viel lernen.

  • Top Gear: Neueste Hardware (Apple) und moderne Tools für deine tägliche Arbeit.

  • Team Fun: Regelmäßige Team-Events und gemeinsame Erlebnisse – zuletzt waren wir Fallschirm springen.

title: Trainee Content Creation (all genders)
company: Miss Germany Studios GmbH & Co. KG
description:
Miss Germany ist kein Schönheitswettbewerb, sondern eine Plattform für Frauen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas bewegen wollen. Wir machen keinen Social-Media-Content von der Stange. Wir erzählen ihre Geschichten, Persönlichkeiten und Momente dort, wo sie gesehen werden: auf YouTube Shorts, Instagram und TikTok.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Short-Form nicht nur schaut, sondern versteht. Jemanden, der in den ersten zwei Sekunden eine Hook setzt, im Rhythmus schneidet und weiß, warum ein Reel durch die Decke geht – und ein anderes nicht.

Als Trainee Content Creation bei Miss Germany Studios schneidest du Short-Form-Content aus unserer YouTube-Serie und Produktionen – und aus Ideen, die du selbst mitbringst. Und wenn es passt, stehst du auch mal selbst vor der Kamera. Dabei lernst du Short-Form von Grund auf in der Praxis und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.

Was du bei uns machst:

Schnitt: Du schneidest Shorts, Reels und TikToks – schnell, plattformgerecht und mit starken Hooks. Aus langen YouTube-Folgen, Event-Material und Behind-the-Scenes machst du Clips, die für sich allein funktionieren.

Trends & Formate: Du weißt, was auf den Plattformen gerade läuft, und bringst eigene Formatideen ein.

Vor der Kamera: Du drehst (dich) auch mal selbst.

Learnings: Du schaust dir an, was performt, und lässt das in die nächsten Videos einfließen.

Wir haben ein Match, wenn Folgendes auf dich zutrifft:

Du lebst Short-Form. Du scrollst nicht einfach – du analysierst ganz automatisch, warum dich ein Video nach zwei Sekunden hat.

Du kannst schneiden. Premiere Pro oder CapCut – Hauptsache, du bist schnell und hast ein Gefühl für Timing, Pacing und Sound.

Du bringst Social-Erfahrung mit. Idealerweise hast du schon Social-Media-Kanäle betreut oder eigenen Content veröffentlicht – für ein Unternehmen, eine Agentur oder deinen eigenen Kanal.

Du hast Creator-Energie. Du wartest nicht auf Briefings, sondern kommst mit Ideen.

Kamera ist kein Problem. Du hast keine Scheu, auch mal selbst vor der Linse zu stehen – musst aber nicht.

Du übernimmst Ownership. Du hältst Deadlines, denkst mit und gehst einen Schritt weiter, statt auf Antworten zu warten.

Du willst durchstarten. Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung abgeschlossen – idealerweise in Medien, Kommunikation oder Film – oder bringst vergleichbare Erfahrung mit,
z. B. durch eigene Kanäle. Ab dem 15. Januar 2027 bist du mit 40 Stunden pro Woche dabei.

Du möchtest etwas aufbauen. Nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten.

Was wir bieten:

Build Something Big: 2027 wird Miss Germany 100 Jahre alt. Du gestaltest unseren Short-Form-Auftritt in genau dieser Phase aktiv mit.

Impact Driven: Wir unterstützen mit Herzblut Frauen bei ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und tragen zu einer vielfältigeren und gleichberechtigteren Gesellschaft bei.

Creator Playground: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, Formate auszuprobieren und gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, was Menschen wirklich bewegt.

Ownership statt Micromanagement: Viel Vertrauen, kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Verantwortung statt endloser Abstimmungsschleifen.

Base Köln/Düsseldorf: Du arbeitest von Köln oder Düsseldorf aus – remote oder im Co-Working-Space. Ein festes Muster gibt es nicht, wir schauen gemeinsam, was passt. Für dein Onboarding sowie regelmäßige Team- und Produktionstage kommst du nach Oldenburg in unser Head Office.

Work with Inspiring People: Du arbeitest mit beeindruckenden Frauen, spannenden Persönlichkeiten, Partnern und einem Netzwerk, das weit über Miss Germany hinausgeht.

Learn Fast: Schnitt, Storytelling, Plattformen, Community, Personal Brands und Medien – du wirst in kurzer Zeit unglaublich viel lernen.

Top Gear: Neueste Hardware (Apple) und moderne Tools für deine tägliche Arbeit.

Team Fun: Regelmäßige Team-Events und gemeinsame Erlebnisse – zuletzt waren wir Fallschirm springen.

description:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?

title: Tritium Process Engineers
company: Personal data collected as part of the application process
description:
About Tritium Fuel Cycle (TFC)

GFG is designing a first-of-a-kind (FOAK) fusion power plant (FPP) to deliver 1 GW of electrical power in the 2040s. The “GIGA” plant will be based on a stellarator magnetic confinement fusion device, operating continuously on a deuterium-tritium (D-T) fuel cycle.  Prior to this, the smaller “Gauss Industrial Demonstrator (GID-170)” will be deployed in the mid-2030s.

While deuterium can be extracted from seawater, tritium is a tightly controlled radioactive isotope with an extremely limited global supply. Therefore, both GID-170 and GIGA must utilise closed tritium fuel cycle infrastructure, to ensure that unburnt tritium is fully recycled back to the stellarator and not released to the environment. Meanwhile, the tritium consumed by the fusion reaction must be replenished using tritium breeding blankets (TBB).

A first-of-a-kind dedicated tritium fuel cycle (TFC) facility, suitable for continuously supporting a stellarator device, must be designed, built and commissioned. It will adopt a multi-loop process architecture, each loop comprising many deeply integrated subsystems. Developing such a facility presents unique engineering challenges: the supply chain is still emerging, commercial process simulation tools lack dedicated TFC libraries, suitable off-the-shelf equipment is not always available, and some technologies have relatively low technology readiness levels (TRLs). 

A conceptual design is currently under development, with the project then progressing into pre-front-end engineering design (pre-FEED) in 2028, followed by front-end engineering design (FEED) and design for manufacturing phases. Completion of the overall design phase (for GID-170) must be achieved by 2032.


About the role

GFG is looking for several Tritium Process Engineers to join the TFC department and develop the GID-170 and GIGA TFC facilities. The roles will contribute to the continued development and optimisation of the overall fuel cycle architecture and its subsystems. Activities will include managing design requirements; developing process flow diagrams (PFDs), piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), heat and mass balances (HMBs) and the Basis of Design (BoD); selecting technologies; sizing and arranging equipment; and contributing to safety-related design. The roles may also involve supporting equipment prototype development and testing with technology developers and research partners.
We welcome candidates with complementary strengths in process design and process modelling and simulation, with systems engineering experience also desirable. These specialisations sit within the same engineering function, and candidates are not expected to have equal expertise across all areas. The number of appointments and balance of responsibilities will reflect the successful candidates’ experience and technical strengths. Drawing on their specialist expertise, successful candidates will work collaboratively on design development, modelling, analysis and optimisation to assess design alternatives and inform robust, well-documented design decisions.
The TFC comprises a wide range of technologies and subsystems, requiring the department to manage multiple sub-projects and work packages in parallel. Each engineer will contribute across several activities and will be expected to take ownership of specific tasks or subsystems, or lead work packages, depending on their experience. The roles will involve close collaboration with engineers from the same and other disciplines at national and international partner organisations, research institutions and suppliers, as well as with colleagues across disciplines and departments within GFG. Given the specific challenges associated with tritium, close collaboration with Nuclear Safety and Export Control specialists will also be essential.
During conceptual design, successful candidates will work closely with the Head of Tritium Fuel Cycle to address the strong interdependencies between subsystems and develop a coherent, integrated design. As the project moves into pre-FEED, they will be expected to take greater day-to-day ownership of their assigned areas and drive design development through pre-FEED and FEED, while maintaining close coordination across subsystem interfaces. As the project progresses, the roles will evolve to support design for manufacture, procurement and commissioning of the GID-170 TFC systems, followed by further development and refinement of the TFC design for GIGA.


Main responsibilities

  • Process definition and systems engineering
    1. Identify, define and manage system requirements and interfaces across TFC subsystems and the overall plant architecture.
    2. Develop and optimise the fuel cycle architecture, assessing alternative subsystem technologies, their respective advantages and disadvantages, technology readiness levels (TRLs), and potential system configurations.
    3. Develop process flow diagrams (PFDs) for individual TFC subsystem blocks and the overall plant architecture.
    4. Participate in the development of piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), identification and sizing of key components, and equipment layout.
    5. Develop and maintain representative heat and mass balances to support process definition, system integration and design decisions.
  • Process modelling and simulation
    1. Develop, apply and improve process simulation models for individual TFC subsystem blocks and the overall plant architecture, using tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen Custom Modeler, Python and dedicated proprietary software, as appropriate.
    2. Support the development and integration of custom models and, where appropriate, contribute to the development of dedicated simulation tools.
    3. Use modelling and simulation to assess system performance, compare technology options and operating configurations, support component sizing, and inform process optimisation and design decisions.
    4. Documentation of assumptions, uncertainty and applicability limits, and perform model validation when suitable data becomes available.
    5. Work collaboratively with internal and external modelling specialists to ensure consistency between simulation results, engineering requirements and the evolving plant design.
  • Cost, safety and risk management
    1. Identify and manage design risks, developing effective risk-reduction strategies and action plans.
    2. Identify applicable standards, regulations and codes, and ensure that these are considered throughout the design process. 
    3. Participate in hazard, safety and accident analyses, including hazard identification (HAZID) and hazard and operability (HAZOP) studies, and contribute to the definition of safety functions and development of the safety case.
    4. Contribute to capital and operational expenditure (CAPEX/OPEX) estimates.
  • Design development and delivery
    1. Develop design documentation and specifications, including contributions to the Basis of Design and design philosophies.
    2. Document design studies, verification and assessment activities, engineering assumptions and design decisions.
    3. Support the design development, procurement and testing of prototypes for key components, in collaboration with technology developers, suppliers and research partners.
    4. Provide engineering support for R&D activities conducted in-house and with external partners and collaborators.
  • Project coordination and collaboration
    1. Lead specific technical tasks or work packages assigned by the Head of TFC, in line with experience and expertise.
    2. Take ownership of specific subsystems throughout the pre-FEED and FEED studies, as assigned by the Head of TFC, in line with experience and expertise.
    3. Participate in technical meetings with partners, suppliers, research institutions and other collaborators.
    4. Collaborate closely with other engineering disciplines and contribute to the integration of TFC systems within the wider fusion plant.
    5. As required, undertake other relevant duties in support of project objectives.
  • GID-170 delivery (in the 2030s)
    1. Support the procurement and installation activities of the GID-170 TFC facilities.
    2. Develop commissioning plans and operating instructions.
The balance between process design, systems engineering, and process modelling and simulation will depend on each candidate’s background and area of expertise. All engineers are expected to work collaboratively across these areas, ensuring that modelling activities inform engineering decisions and that process design is supported by robust analysis.


Qualification and educational requirements

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in chemical engineering, process engineering, nuclear engineering, or a closely related discipline*. 

*In the case of a closely related discipline, the degree should be supported by relevant chemical engineering experience.

  • A minimum of 3 years design experience working as a Process Engineer in an industrial environment.

    Additional desirable qualifications relevant to process modelling and simulation:
  • A PhD or EngD in Chemical or Process Engineering or a closely related field.


Competences and preferred skills

1. Common skills

Essential

All applicants should demonstrate:

  • In-depth knowledge of chemical engineering principles, including thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics, and relevant transport phenomena.
  • Experience in the development of industrial-scale process engineering installations in complex environments requiring regulatory approval (ideally nuclear projects or similar).
  • Experience in the development of processes involving different fluids and conditions (cryogenic, vacuum, atmospheric pressure gas, high-pressure gas (up to 100 bara), liquid, etc.).
  • Experience in the design and development of integrated treatment unit operations (purification, separation, conditioning, etc.), ideally in the gas phase, and in the hydrogen or nuclear sectors.
  • Proficiency in at least one established process simulation tool, such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, UniSim, gPROMS, ProMax, CHEMCAD or equivalent.
  • Experience in requirements capture, documentation and management.
  • Experience working alongside multiple other engineering disciplines, such as mechanical, electrical, control, thermal and nuclear engineers.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams of engineers, technologists and physicists.
  • A proactive and self-motivated approach, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.
  • Professional working proficiency in English. 

Desirable

All applicants would benefit from demonstrating:

  • Knowledge of tritium fuel cycle technologies and/or hydrogen isotope separation. Hands-on experience working with tritium would be an advantage.
  • Experience with the design or analysis of pumping technologies, heat exchangers or other key process equipment.
  • Familiarity with magnetic fusion systems and/or nuclear power plant systems.
  • Familiarity with environmental, nuclear safety and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
  • Knowledge of systems engineering and an understanding of configuration management and risk management.
  • Understanding of equipment qualification, manufacture, testing, inspection and pragmatic usability.
  • Knowledge of German or other European languages.

2. Specialist Skills

Candidates are expected to demonstrate strengths in one or more of the following areas, depending on their background and specialisation.

Process design and systems engineering

  • Experience in developing process architectures, heat and mass balances, PFDs and P&IDs, and in supporting equipment selection, sizing and integration.
  • Experience in developing Basis of Design (BoD) documentation, design philosophies, specifications, design descriptions and justifications.
  • Ability to assess alternative process technologies and configurations, considering performance, safety, technical maturity and operational requirements.
  • Experience in translating system requirements and process analysis into engineering specifications and design decisions.
  • Familiarity with process safety codes, standards and regulations, as well as safety-by-design principles, including the ALARA (As Low As Reasonably Achievable) approach.
  • Experience in engaging with potential technology suppliers and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

Process modelling and simulation

  • Proficiency in process modelling tools such as Aspen Custom Modeler, gPROMS custom modelling or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scientific computing language, such as Python, Julia, MATLAB, Octave or C++.
  • Strong understanding of numerical methods applied to chemical engineering, including ordinary and partial differential equations (ODEs and PDEs), differential-algebraic equations (DAEs), discretisation techniques and numerical convergence.
  • Knowledge of numerical optimisation methods and their implementation, with the ability to apply them to process analysis and design optimisation.
  • Experience developing custom process models, integrating subsystem models or analysing dynamic process behaviour, along with model automation and analysis, to assess system performance, compare design options and support process optimisation is an advantage.


We are recruiting engineers with complementary technical strengths. Applicants who meet the common essential criteria and have relevant capability in one specialist profile are encouraged to apply; experience in every technology or software package listed is not expected.


The balance of responsibilities and the level of technical ownership will be agreed according to each successful candidate’s experience and the needs of the programme, with opportunities for candidates to grow and develop into greater technical ownership.

title: Core Account Executive - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

In this role, you will: 

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices


Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in Enterprise level accounts, winning multiple $100k+ ARR transactions
  • Proven expertise winning new business logos through a repeatable sales motion
  • Demonstrable expertise in strategic outbound prospecting, particularly via inside sales
  • Experience handling enterprise deal sizes with multiple stakeholders at C-Level

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MEDDIC experience or similar (Sandler Pain Funnel, etc)
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset. 
  • Awards for top achievement (President's club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

In this position, you will work closely with product and platform engineering teams, helping them turn machine learning models into maintainable production applications. Combining strong software engineering expertise with a pragmatic architectural mindset, you will establish reusable solutions, improve integration with the AI platform and support teams in making sound technical decisions.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Join a world-leading, high-end CAE software company operating at the forefront of automotive technology.

  • Work with cutting-edge technologies at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning and cloud applications.

  • Collaborate with international product and platform engineering teams in a respectful and knowledge-driven environment.

  • Benefit from continuous professional development, training and opportunities to expand your technical expertise.

title: Finance Controller
description:
Finance Controller

Location: Netherlands

Start date: Q1 2027

Compensation: €70k - €80k annually (depending on experience)

Employment type: Full-time (contractor if outside Netherlands)

About DTACT

DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data.

As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most.

The Role

We are looking for a Finance Controller to own DTACT’s finance function end-to-end as we continue to scale internationally. Reporting into the COO, you’ll take full ownership of accounting, collections, financial analytics, budgeting, and compliance (including our Dutch statutory obligations) — acting as the single point of accountability for finance in the business today. This is a hands-on, mid-level role: you’ll be expected to run the entire finance function largely on your own in the near term, while also bringing the leadership mindset and ambition to grow the function — and your own role — as DTACT expands.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end accounting operations — AP/AR, general ledger, and month end/year-end close — ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting.

  • Manage the full collections process: invoicing, aging follow-up, and cash flow forecasting.

  • Build and maintain finance analytics (dashboards, reports) that give leadership clear, real-time visibility into company performance.

  • Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle, partnering with department leads to track actuals against plan.

  • Ensure full compliance with Dutch tax and statutory reporting requirements (VAT, annual accounts) and manage relationships with external accountants, auditors, banks, and tax advisors.

  • Partner with People Operations on payroll processing and accuracy across jurisdictions, and own administration of the employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).

  • Build and continuously improve finance processes, technical efficiencies and controls, laying the groundwork as the company grows.

What you'll bring

  • 5–8 years of progressive finance/accounting experience, including hands-on ownership of a full finance function — ideally within tech in a startup or scale-up environment.

  • Solid knowledge of Dutch accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory compliance requirements and payroll.

  • Proven ability to independently manage accounting, collections, budgeting, and financial analytics without a large supporting team.

  • Strong analytical skills and financial modeling ability; comfortable turning data into clear, actionable insights.

  • Leadership potential and genuine ambition to grow into a finance leadership role as the team and company scale.

  • A hands-on, “roll up your sleeves” attitude, paired with the ability to think and plan strategically.

  • Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch.

What's in for you

  • Competitive compensation and equity participation, including an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing you to share in DTACT's long-term success.

  • Remote-first flexibility, with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs.

  • A trust-based culture built around asynchronous communication, empowering people to work independently while staying connected and aligned across teams.

  • Generous time off, including vacation days and local public holidays to help you rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Home office support, including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace.

  • An international and diverse team, where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives.

  • High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats.

We believe diverse teams build better solutions.

DTACT welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity. We hire based on skills, experience, and potential, and encourage everyone who meets the role requirements to apply.

Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence.

title: Commercial Account Executive, META
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Role Description

Help shape the next stage of Horizon3.ai’s META growth. Based in the Netherlands with regular travel to the region, you’ll bring autonomous pentesting to new customers and help them reduce real-world security risk. If you thrive on opening doors, building partnerships and turning opportunities into wins, this is a chance to make a visible impact as we expand our META Commercial team.

We currently require our Amsterdam team to come to the office 2 - 3 days per week.

What You’ll Do

Grow Horizon3.ai’s META Commercial business by winning new customers, developing productive channel partnerships and helping organisations realise value from our cybersecurity solutions.

  • Win new accounts and expand our customer base by introducing disruptive cybersecurity software solutions to the META market.

  • Build and convert a qualified pipeline, owning the sales cycle from qualification and proof of value through negotiation and close, with the goal of exceeding quota consistently quarter over quarter.

  • Turn channel partnerships into revenue by proactively engaging regional resellers and developing joint opportunities.

  • Demonstrate Horizon3.ai solutions in virtual and in-person meetings, connecting technical capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes.

  • Drive the post-proof of value ROI process, helping customers understand business value while building relationships that support satisfaction and retention.

  • Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline data and forecasts in Salesforce so opportunities, risks and next steps are clearly understood.

  • Work independently to progress opportunities while collaborating with distributed sales, support and customer success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 3-5 years of successful cybersecurity sales experience, with a track record of driving growth, introducing disruptive software solutions and consistently exceeding quarterly quotas.

  • Previous experience selling technical solutions into the META region.

  • Experience establishing and monetising channel partnerships; existing relationships with key regional resellers are essential.

  • Proficiency across the full sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, deal closure and post-proof of value ROI management.

  • The ability to present and demonstrate cybersecurity solutions effectively, both virtually and in person.

  • Strong CRM discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline records and forecasts in Salesforce (SFDC).

  • Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling-type methodologies and sales tools such as Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Slack.

  • The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams.

  • Fluency in English and Arabic; additional language skills such as French are welcomed.

Travel Required

We are a hybrid company, and this job will require you to spend 3 days based at our Amsterdam city centre sales hub. The role may require up to 40% of travel within the assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3.ai

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3.ai is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3.ai, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3.ai, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

title: Internal Communications Internship
description:
About the role

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

As our Internal Communications Intern, you’ll join our Marketing & Communications team and help keep colleagues across SkyNRG informed, connected and engaged. Working closely with our PR & Communications Manager and teams across the business, you’ll create engaging content, support internal campaigns and events, and help improve the channels and tools we use to communicate.

Your Responsibilities

  • Content creation: Draft and publish newsletters, intranet articles, announcements, interviews, employee stories and leadership updates.

  • Employee engagement: Support internal campaigns, company events and town halls that connect and engage colleagues across SkyNRG.

  • Channels & tools: Maintain internal communication channels and content calendars and help improve the processes and tools behind them.

  • Collaboration: Work with teams across the organization to gather information and turn it into clear and engaging communication.

  • Insights & improvement: Monitor engagement and use insights to continuously improve our internal communications.

Your profile

You recognize yourself in the following:

title: Regulatory and Start Up Specialist
description:
Precision for Medicine is a global Clinical Research Organization with uniquely integrated offering which enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas.

Due to our continued growth we are seeking a Regulatory and Start Up Specialist based in the UK to join our growing team. Apart from the experience with regulatory submissions, candidates will ideally also have contracts and budgets negotiation experience for the UK.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Responsible for delivery, in terms of timeliness and quality, of site activation readiness within the assigned country/sites and foreseeing and mitigating any risks.

  • Preparation of Clinical Trial Application Forms as well as preparation of submission dossier (initial and amendments/notifications) for submission to Competent Authorities, Ethics Committees, and other applicable local bodies according to local requirements and within required timelines to obtain all necessary authorizations/approvals for the conduct of the Clinical Trial according to international and local/national applicable regulations, company SOPs and principles of ICH-GCP.
  • Interaction with CA/EC for study purposes and handling responses to the CA/EC.
  • Providing regular updates about CA and EC submissions to the Start Up Lead and/or Regulatory Lead assigned to the study and to Project Manager/Project Team
  • Maintenance of project plans, project trackers and regulatory intelligence tools as it pertains to assigned responsibilities and to keep Regulatory Leadership
  • Preparation/Support the development of study specific start-up plans, IMP release requirements and essential document review criteria.
  • Partner with the assigned site CRA to ensure alignment in communication and secure site
  • Review and manage collection of essential documents required for site activation/IMP release.
  • Customize country/site specific Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form.
  • Responsible for/facilitates the translation and co-ordination of translations for documents.
  • Maintain communication with other key functions participating to country start up e., Feasibility, Clinical Operations, Project Management, Regulatory, and Site Contracts management group on project specific status and deliverables.
  • Act as SME for collection and maintenance of site level critical path to Site Activation data points, including but not limited to Competent Authority, local IRB/Ethics Committee (EC) timelines, site contracts and budget negotiation requirements for and other required reviews to secure on time site activation for the assigned sites in the country.
  • When required, participate/support the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee department.
  • May participate/support feasibility group in site outreach to assess potential interest of investigators to a potential study.
  • Keep an updated knowledge of the local clinical trial laws, regulations and help distributing their knowledge within PFM to ensure the conduct of Clinical Trials according to international and local/national applicable regulations.
  • Maintain audit/inspection readiness at all times and file documents as per TMF plan and/ or study specific plans in the relevant TMF
  • May support the clinical team performing Pre-Study Site Visits.

The ideal candidate will have:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related field (ideally in a scientific or healthcare discipline), or Registered Nurse (RN) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • A qualification in Pharmacy/ work experience as a Pharmacist would be highly beneficial.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience.

Other Required:

  • Previous experience working as a Regulatory and Start Up Specialist or Site Contracts Specialists in either a CRO or pharmaceutical/ biotech industry or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.
  • Experience using computerized information systems, electronic spreadsheets, word processing and electronic mail required.
  • Fluency in English

Preferred:

  • Relevant regulatory and site start-up (feasibility, contract negotiations, CA/ EC/ IRB submissions) experience.
  • Experience in site contract and budget negotiation would be a strong plus.
  • Experience using milestone tracking tools/systems.
  • Ability to prioritize workload to meet deadlines
  • Advanced degree in medical or life sciences (MD, PhD, PharmD)/RAC certification/Masters in Regulatory Science.
