title: Content Reviewer - United States
description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
 
Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMastâ¢ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing networkâcombining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Quality Engineer to strengthen our quality systems and support rising production volumes across Quartermasterâs SmartMastâ¢ systems and related marine products. This role will help us reduce defects and field returns, lead structured root-cause investigations, and keep our hardware manufacturing and deployment operations audit-ready as we scale globally. The right candidate has strong hands-on experience building practical quality management processes for electromechanical hardware in demanding environments, and can partner effectively across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturers to catch issues early and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and scale our Quality Management System (QMS), standard operating procedures, and inspection protocols to ensure continuous audit readiness (e.g., ISO 9001 / AS9100 standards).

  • Lead structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) investigations (8D, 5-Whys, Fishbone) for manufacturing non-conformances, test failures, and field/customer returns.

  • Partner with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers during New Product Introduction (NPI) to establish Design for Quality (DFQ), PFMEA, control plans, and incoming/in-process/final acceptance test criteria.

  • Track, analyze, and report key quality metrics (yield, defect rates, RMA/field return trends, supplier performance) to drive measurable reductions in defects and hardware rework.

  • Collaborate with contract manufacturers and component suppliers on First Article Inspections (FAI), supplier audits, non-conforming material review (MRB), and corrective action follow-through.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Bachelorâs degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Quality Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3â5+ years of experience in quality engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

  • Strong command of root-cause analysis and quality tools (CAPA, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and First Article Inspection).

  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers to qualify parts, resolve production defects, and enforce quality standards.

  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or AS9100 quality frameworks and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across remote engineering teams, field operations, and manufacturing partners.

  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Six Sigma certification is a plus.

Work Environment:

  • Flexible working hours, with occasional intensive sprints aligned to production milestones and audits.

  • Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, suppliers, or field deployment sites.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customerâs broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read thisÂ blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

description:
Die Stelle in Kürze

Wir bei Kopfsachen vermitteln in verschiedenen Bildungsformaten die Grundlagen der mentalen Gesundheitskompetenz. Unsere Mission ist es, mentale Gesundheit für junge Menschen verständlich und zugänglich zu machen. Als Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) im Bereich Workshop- und Ehrenamtsmanagement erhältst du einen vielseitigen Einblick in unsere operative Arbeit, von der Organisation unserer Workshops bis zur Unterstützung unseres ehrenamtlichen Workshopleitungs-Teams. Du sorgst mit Struktur, Kommunikationsgeschick und Freude an der Teamarbeit dafür, dass unsere Workshops organisatorisch reibungslos ablaufen und junge Menschen von unserer Arbeit profitieren.

  • Standort: Frankfurt 
  • Arbeitszeit: 10h pro Woche 
  • Startdatum: 01. Januar
  • Vorerst befristet auf 1 Jahr


Deine Mission

Als Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) im Bereich Workshop- und Ehrenamtsmanagement trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Workshops an Schulen in Frankfurt und Rhein-Main-Gebiet professionell vorbereitet, begleitet und nachbereitet werden. Mit deinem Blick für Prozesse und Organisation trägst du zur Etablierung des jungen Standortes bei. Dabei verfolgst du das Ziel, mentale Gesundheitskompetenz an Schulen zu stärken.


Deine Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben umfassen unter anderem:

  • Koordination & Kommunikation: 
    • Unterstützung bei der organisatorischen Vorbereitung von Workshops
    • Prüfen, ob alle relevanten Informationen für die Workshopleitungen vorliegen und richtig im System hinterlegt sind.
    • Betreuung und Koordination neuer Workshopleitungen im Rahmen ihres Onboardings und darüber hinaus.
    • Bereitstellung des Feedbacks von Schülerinnen und Schülern
    • Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung und Gestaltung von Teamtreffen
  • Rechercheaufträge und Netzwerkpflege:
    • Zuarbeit im Bereich Schulakquise, z. B. Recherche bestimmter Schulprogramme, aktueller politischer Entwicklungen und Vorbereitung von Rundmails.
    • Zuarbeit im Bereich Fundraising, z. B. Recherche potentieller neuer regionaler Förderpartner und aktueller Ausschreibungen; Verfassen von Projektberichten etc.
  • Administrative Aufgaben:
    • Prüfung von Abrechnungen und Nachweisen.
    • Ausstellung von Ehrenamtsbescheinigungen.


Dein Profil

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, gewissenhaft und selbstständig auch in remote-Settings.
  • Du hast Freude an Admin- und Organisation, Kommunikation und Teamarbeit.
  • Du bist im Studium eingeschrieben (mindestens noch 1 Jahr) – Studiengänge mit psychologischem und/oder pädagogischem-Bezug sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
  • Du bringst eine hohe Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit.
  • Du wohnst in Frankfurt oder Umgebung und hast Lust, regional zu wirken.  
  • Erste Arbeitserfahrung im Bereich Bildung, Projektmanagement oder als Workshopleitung sind ein Plus.
  • Du hast bereits erste Arbeitserfahrungen mit unterschiedlichen Projektmanagement-Tools gesammelt.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1).


Unser Angebot

  • Eine bedeutungsvolle Mission: Du arbeitest an einer Aufgabe, die wirklich einen Unterschied im Leben junger Menschen macht.
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & Eigenverantwortung: Raum für Mitgestaltung, Verantwortung und eigene Ideen.
  • Teamspirit & Wertschätzung: Offenes, unterstützendes Team mit regelmäßigem Feedback und engem Austausch.
  • Flexible Arbeitsweise: Kombination aus Arbeiten im Frankfurter Büro und Homeoffice.
  • Innovatives Umfeld: Ein junges Social Start-up mit viel Raum für Lernen und persönliche Entwicklung.
Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich alle qualifizierten Personen, sich bei uns zu bewerben – insbesondere Menschen mit Migrationsgeschichte, BIPoC, Menschen der LGBTQIA+ Community sowie Menschen mit Behinderungen. Wir freuen uns auch auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About Dataro

Dataro is a fast-growing tech company with a bold mission: set a new standard in charity fundraising. Our AI-driven SaaS tools help nonprofits raise more funds and make a bigger impact in the world. We work with more than 250 organisations across 20+ countries - including UNICEF, Greenpeace, Amnesty International and Save the Children - and we’re looking for someone to help us reach many more of them across the UK and Europe.

We closed a Series A funding round in February 2026, led by Blueprint Equity, and are investing that backing into growing the UK and European business.

About the Role

As our Sales Development Representative for the UK and Europe, you’ll be the first point of contact between Dataro and the fundraising leaders at large charities across the region. You’ll find the organisations with a problem worth solving, work out who inside them owns it, and open the conversations that let our Account Executives take things forward.

This is an outbound role and it sits at the front of everything we do commercially in the region. You’ll report directly to our Head of Region, UK & Europe, and work day to day alongside two Account Executives. You’ll own your own patch of target accounts across the UK and continental Europe.

This role is ideal for someone a few years into their sales career who wants a real patch rather than a script, and who is ready to move quickly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research and prioritise target charities across the UK and Europe, using our ideal customer criteria and live buying signals rather than working an undifferentiated list.

  • Run multi-channel outbound - email, LinkedIn and phone - leading with a relevant insight about the prospect’s fundraising programme, not a product pitch.

  • Map the buying group, identifying the fundraising managers, data leads and individual giving specialists who feel the problem day to day, and understanding how decisions actually get made inside each organisation.

  • Qualify hard and disqualify quickly. A fast no is more useful than a long maybe, for us and for the prospect.

  • Book and hand over qualified meetings, with enough context that the Account Executive walks in properly prepared.

  • Work across European markets, adapting your approach to local fundraising practice - the sector looks quite different in the Nordics, the Netherlands and the UK.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate - accounts, contacts, sequences, activity and notes.

  • Act as the voice of the market internally, feeding what you hear back to Sales, Marketing and Product. You’ll be closer to prospective customers than almost anyone else in the business.

Qualifications & Key Skills

  • 1–3 years’ experience in an outbound SDR or BDR role, ideally B2B SaaS.

  • Demonstrable track record of meeting and exceeding outbound activity and meeting targets.

  • AI Native - foundational understanding of AI-based efficiency tools (e.g. Claude), and a habit of using them.

  • Clear, plain written English. Most of your first impressions will be made in writing, and charity audiences respond badly to hype.

  • Comfortable with structure and discipline: sequences, activity cadence, CRM hygiene.

  • Interest in the nonprofit sector and a genuine curiosity about how charities raise money — direct mail, regular giving, digital, major gifts.

  • Familiarity with nonprofit CRM platforms (e.g. Raiser’s Edge, Salesforce NPSP, Blackbaud, Microsoft Dynamics) is useful but not required.

  • Experience with HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus.

Soft Skills & Qualities that make a great candidate

  • High Agency - you don’t wait to be told what to do. You see broken things and fix them.

  • Hustle - you stay in the fight when things get hard.

  • AI-First mindset - you use every tool at your disposal to move faster and think bigger.

  • Cares about the Mission - you genuinely care about helping nonprofits raise more money to change the world.


Contract Details

Contract type:

Permanent, full-time. Employed by Dataro Limited (UK).

Start date:

1 November 2026.

Location:

United Kingdom. The role is remote, with occasional travel to London for team meetings and to in-person client or sector events as needed.

Salary Range:

£37,000-£40,000 base salary based on location and experience, plus commission

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Agon

Agon is building Europe’s defence AI lab. We develop the sovereign infrastructure and AI foundation models to train, test and evolve autonomous defence systems, in Europe and for Europe. At the heart of it is a synthetic battlefield: a virtual testing ground where drones, vessels and other autonomous systems face adaptive adversaries at scale, and where their failure modes are exposed before they ever deploy. We work as a neutral partner to defence manufacturers and governments.

Founded in London in January 2026, we’ve raised $100M to date. Our $70M Series A, at a $450M valuation, was led by Northzone alongside Lakestar, Lux Capital and XYZ, with backing from former Sequoia Capital head Roelof Botha. It was also the first joint investment by the UK Government’s Sovereign AI Fund and the National Security Strategic Investment Fund.

Between them, our founders have helped build one of the defining defence-tech companies of the last decade, and started an aerospace company from scratch. Around them is a founding team hand-picked from Europe’s best engineers, each at the top of their field, and brought together to build this. We’re scaling fast across our offices in London and Berlin.

The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll be the technical bridge between Agon’s AI development environment and our customers’ real-world model development workflows. You’ll work in small teams and own end-to-end delivery of high-stakes projects.

You’ll embed with customers, working in their models, data and pipelines, and integrate our platform so their teams can build, simulate and validate AI systems at scale. Using our fast-evolving product suite, you’ll stand up in days a development environment that would take customers years to build in-house.

Our FDEs come in different flavours. Some are strongest in software integration, others in modelling and simulation or AI. Every FDE works directly with customers, writes production software and builds a strong understanding of the defence domain. If you’re strong in software and with customers but new to defence, we’d still like to hear from you.

This role is based in London, with regular travel to customer sites and our Berlin office, mainly within Europe.

What you’ll do

  • Deploy and integrate: work directly with customers to deploy and operationalise Agon’s AI development environment, connecting it to their models, data sources and pipelines.

  • Solve broad technical problems: tackle software engineering, simulation and synthetic-data pipelines, ML workflows, cloud infrastructure and system deployment.

  • Bridge systems: connect customer-built systems to Agon’s platform to deliver real value quickly.

  • Build repeatable approaches: design architectures and ways of working that make customer projects consistent and scalable.

  • Own outcomes: drive projects to completion, adapting as requirements and priorities change.

  • Be the voice of the customer: feed real-world friction and needs back to our product and engineering teams.

What you’ll bring

  • A strong engineering background: ideally in computer science, robotics or a related discipline.

  • Production software skills: proficiency in Python and at least one other production language, such as C++, Go, Java or TypeScript.

  • Integration experience: you’ve helped integrate and deploy complex systems.

  • Familiarity with AI and ML workflows: ideally including simulation, synthetic data, or model testing and validation.

  • Customer focus: excellent communication, and experience driving customer engagements to success.

  • Independence: you solve problems well and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • The right attitude: your references would describe you as low-ego, highly motivated, thoughtfully opinionated, a strong communicator and a curious listener.

  • Willingness to travel: to work on site with customers and between our offices, mainly within Europe.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering or field engineering role

  • Aerospace or defence experience

  • Deep expertise in modelling and simulation, or in AI, ML or optimisation such as reinforcement learning

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure), containers and CI/CD

  • Experience with data engineering, MLOps or integrations with third-party systems

What we offer

We pay at the top of the market we compete in, and everyone is an owner.

  • Pay: salary at the 90th percentile of the companies we compete with, benchmarked by role, level and location.

  • Equity: every permanent employee holds options. New hires receive options worth their base salary, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff.

  • Cash and equity choice: trade some salary for more options, or some options for more cash.

  • Pension: 5% employer and 5% employee contributions on full base salary.

  • Real impact: you’ll shape how Agon works with customers while our FDE team is still small.

How we work

Our values shape how we work: All as One Company, Take Extreme Ownership, Low Ego, Be Bold, and Remember Who We Serve. We prefer clear written thinking to polished slides, and we hold a high bar.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you’re excited by this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still like to hear from you.

Why work at Higgsfield AI?

We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

The role

Higgsfield is opening enterprise sales in Europe. You will own enterprise revenue in France and the Benelux (Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg), across two verticals. The first is advertising: brands, agencies and ad platforms. The second is video production: production companies, studios and post-production houses. You also pick up gaming accounts in the region. This is a proactive hunting role. You find the accounts, open the conversations, run the deals and close them yourself.

What you will do

  • Win new enterprise customers. Source, run and close multimillion deals with large advertisers, digital-first brands and agency groups.

  • Own the advertising vertical.

    • Brands: direct contracts with marketing and performance teams.

    • Agencies: enterprise packages for creative, production and media agencies.

    • Platforms: partnerships and integrations with ad and marketing platforms.

  • Own the video production vertical. Source and close enterprise deals with production companies, film and TV studios and post-production houses. You also cover gaming publishers and developers in the region.

  • Run complex deals. Work with marketing, performance, creative, procurement, legal and security teams on the customer side. Sales cycles run 6–12 months.

  • Turn pilots into annual contracts. Agree a paid pilot with clear success criteria and convert it into a yearly commitment.

  • Share customer feedback. Tell product and leadership what customers ask for, what blocks deals and what competitors offer.

Requirements

  • Enterprise AE experience. 4+ years as a B2B Enterprise Account Executive in a closing role, managing the full sales cycle. You have carried a multimillion annual new-business quota and met or exceeded it in most years.

  • Deals of $1M+ ARR. You have personally closed deals of $1M+ ARR in the last three years and can describe them in detail: who signed, how long the deal took, and what procurement and legal required.

  • Complex sales. Experience with 6–12 month sales cycles and several decision-makers, including C-level and VP-level buyers. You have negotiated enterprise contracts yourself and taken them through procurement, legal and security reviews.

  • Pipeline and forecasting. You build most of your pipeline through your own outbound, forecast accurately and keep the CRM up to date.

  • Agency or brand-side experience. You have worked on the agency side or the brand side. You understand the full marketing budget stack: how spend is split across media, creative, production and technology, who controls each budget line, and how brands, agencies, ad platforms and measurement providers work together.

  • Languages. Fluent French and English, written and spoken, at the level needed to negotiate and close enterprise contracts. Dutch is a major advantage.

  • France and Benelux. Based in Paris, Amsterdam or Brussels, with the right to work in the EU and existing relationships with decision-makers at advertisers and agency groups in France, Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg.

Skills

  • Proactive hunting. You map the market, go after target accounts yourself and build your own pipeline. You do not rely on inbound leads.

  • Stakeholder management. You manage several decision-makers in one deal at the same time.

  • Commercial skills. You can put together an offer with seats, usage commitments and a pilot.

  • Agency knowledge. You understand agency economics and how holding groups buy at group, network and production-unit level.

  • Partnerships. You can run a platform integration deal together with a Solutions Engineer.

  • Product knowledge. You run your own demos in Higgsfield and use AI tools in your daily work.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling generative AI, creative automation or video technology.

  • Background in performance marketing: creative testing, attribution, and the Meta, Google and TikTok ad platforms.

  • At least one partnership or integration deal closed with a platform.

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 230,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.

That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first.

As our new Paid Media Specialist, you'll plan, run, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns for Kinsta. You'll join our Performance Marketing team, report to the Paid Media Team Lead, and work closely with Demand Generation, Design, and RevOps to deliver a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue that supports Kinsta's growth goals. It's a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable with data and enjoys testing new ideas.

Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition.

You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. We work with teams across the globe, so you should be used to collaborating asynchronously and flexible enough to join the occasional early or late call. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative.

What You Will Do:

  • Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition.

  • Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient.

  • Run audience research and competitive analysis to find new opportunities for growth.

  • Develop and run A/B tests across ad messaging, creative assets, audiences, and landing pages.

  • Own conversion tracking: implement, maintain, and troubleshoot it through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific pixels and tags, and work with marketing and technical teams to keep conversion events and attribution accurate.

  • Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights.

  • Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities.

  • Support our paid media strategy: follow advertising trends and platform updates, and recommend ways to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and overall marketing ROI.

  • Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives.

What You Bring To The Role:

  • 2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry.

  • Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags.

  • A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations.

  • Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition.

  • Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once.

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

  • Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack.

  • Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites.

  • Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

  • Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development.

Our Benefits:

  • Annual remote expense budget.

  • Flexible PTO.

  • Paid parental leave.

  • Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta.

  • Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter).

  • Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary.

  • Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA.

title: Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting Sr Analyst
description:
Role Description

As a Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting Sr. Analyst on the Finance team, you will play a key role in supporting quarterly and annual external reporting, SEC filing coordination, and the broader close process. You will independently manage recurring reporting workstreams, help keep critical timelines on track, and contribute to accurate, thoughtful, and audit-ready external reporting.

This role sits at the intersection of financial reporting and technical accounting. In addition to coordinating core reporting deliverables, you will partner across Accounting, Legal, FP&A, Equity Ops, Tax, Investor Relations, senior Finance leadership, and external auditors to support disclosure processes, governance materials, and reporting requirements tied to complex accounting matters.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex processes, thrives in fast-paced environments, and wants to deepen their experience in both SEC reporting and technical accounting. You will gain exposure to new accounting standard adoption, disclosure analysis, and transaction-related workstreams, including M&A and other strategic projects.

Responsibilities

  • Independently manage recurring financial reporting and close workstreams, including journal entry preparation, reconciliations, and financial analysis, with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
  • Support quarterly and annual SEC reporting activities, including preparation and coordination for Forms 10-Q and 10-K.
  • Coordinate timelines, stakeholder feedback, and sign-offs across Accounting, Legal, FP&A, Equity Ops, Tax, Investor Relations, senior Finance leadership, and external auditors.
  • Prepare and maintain reporting support, disclosure checklists, sign-off packages, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Support materials for Disclosure Committee, Audit Committee, earnings-related deliverables, and other reporting governance processes.
  • Partner on technical accounting matters that have disclosure or external reporting implications, including adoption of new accounting standards such as ASU 2024-03, Disaggregation of Income Statement Expenses (“DISE”).
  • Contribute to technical accounting and special projects, including M&A, strategic transactions, and other non-routine accounting matters.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of relevant experience in financial reporting, technical accounting, audit, or corporate accounting.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial statement reporting.
  • Experience supporting SEC reporting processes, including 10-Q and 10-K preparation and review.
  • Experience working in reporting at a publicly traded company.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional partners.
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • CPA preferred.
  • Experience with technical accounting topics, including new accounting standard adoption, complex accounting issues, and disclosure analysis.
  • Experience preparing or supporting technical accounting memoranda, reporting support, or external reporting disclosures.
  • Experience supporting M&A, strategic transactions, or other special accounting projects.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: MDM Technical Architect
description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled MDM Technical Architect to join our innovative and dynamic team.

MDM Technical Architect | About You

As an MDM Technical Architect, you will define the end-to-end architecture for enterprise Master Data Management, identity resolution, data quality, governance, and analytics solutions. You will establish the technical vision and design for integrating multiple source systems into a governed Microsoft Fabric and OneLake ecosystem, creating trusted golden records that support enterprise reporting and analytics. You bring deep expertise in MDM architecture, entity modeling, match and survivorship strategies, data stewardship, cloud data platforms, and enterprise security, along with the ability to guide stakeholders through complex platform and architecture decisions.

MDM Technical Architect | Day-to-Day

  • Define the overall MDM solution vision and architecture, covering source ingestion, entity and relationship modeling, identity resolution, source crosswalks, survivorship, golden records, stewardship, security, governance, and downstream consumption.
  • Evaluate commercial MDM platforms and custom cloud-native approaches, recommending the right solution based on scalability, licensing, stewardship, operating-model, and long-term support requirements.
  • Design integration patterns across enterprise source systems, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric Data Factory, dbt, APIs, Power BI, and related analytics platforms.
  • Define deterministic and probabilistic matching strategies, confidence thresholds, duplicate detection, household resolution, survivorship rules, and exception-review processes.
  • Establish architectural guardrails for data quality, metadata, lineage, auditability, PII protection, role-based access, environment separation, and deployment governance.
  • Lead architecture workshops and design reviews, translating business requirements and source-data realities into solution blueprints, logical data models, source-to-target mappings, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Guide technical teams through implementation, resolve complex architectural issues, and ensure delivery remains aligned with approved enterprise, security, and governance standards.
  • Define production-readiness, transition, and support requirements, including monitoring, operational runbooks, knowledge transfer, and sustainable platform ownership.

MDM Technical Architect | Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Solution Architecture, MDM, Data Engineering, or Enterprise Data Management, including leadership of complex MDM or data-modernization programs.
  • Deep expertise in MDM architecture, entity resolution, golden-record design, match/merge, survivorship, crosswalks, hierarchy and relationship management, and data stewardship.
  • Strong architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric Data Factory, Azure, dbt, Power BI, lakehouse or medallion architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing commercial MDM platforms such as Profisee, Informatica MDM, Reltio, Ataccama, or Stibo Systems, or designing custom cloud-native identity-resolution solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, security, PII protection, least-privilege access, auditability, and regulated-data practices.
  • Excellent client-facing architecture, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to explain platform options, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive, business, and technical stakeholders.
